recovery rowはformal command failureまたはscheduled no-goを検出したcheckpoint ownerだけがowner-approved inputから生成する。exact trigger evidenceはfailed checkpoint ID／attempt ID／command ID／failure result digestで、calibration／qualificationなら対応external receiptのsemantic digestとraw byte SHAもpayload surfaceへ含める。同じfailed attemptのrecovery rowはprevious authority bundle末尾からgapなしに連鎖し、affected product ownerを含む全approvalがcurrent payloadへ一致するlatest rowを末尾に持つfresh authority bundleのroot／manifest digest／latest logical refだけを次のfresh Entryへ渡す。recoveryはscheduled IDを消費せず、後日のsuccessful phase Exitで対応scheduled rowをexact 1件生成する。

`test:fsmc:pre-i0-foundation`は単なるNode test aliasではなく、registryからだけ起動するcoordinatorである。同じPRE attempt／base／candidate／単一monotonic deadlineを`test:fsmc:pre-i0-foundation:unit`、`calibrate:fsmc:pre-i0-timebox -- --functional-evidence false --receipt-out <fresh>`、`verify:fsmc:client-support -- --require-approved --decision <tracked-owner-decision> --verification-receipt-out <fresh>`、`verify:fsmc:delivery-readiness -- --require-approved --decision <tracked-owner-decision> --approval-evidence-manifest docs/verification/fsmc/delivery-approval-evidence/manifest.json --verification-receipt-out <fresh>`へ順に渡し、各childをexact 1回実行する。support／delivery verifierはowner decisionを生成・補完せずread-only検証し、workspace外fresh verification receiptだけを出力する。unit childはregistryのPRE-owned exact 10 test pathとresolved argv／discovered／executed setをbijection検証し、`run-pre-i0-handoff.test.mjs`欠落、extra、重複を失敗にする。delivery verifierは既存`run-pre-i0-foundation.test.mjs`のdependencyとしてpositive／negativeを持つためtest path cardinalityを増やさない。成功outputはexact `{ unitResultDigest, serializerRewireEvidencePath, serializerRewireEvidenceDigest, comparisonBaseApprovalPath, comparisonBaseApprovalDigest, timeboxReceiptPath, timeboxCalibrationDigest, supportDecisionPath, supportDecisionDigest, supportVerificationReceiptPath, supportVerificationReceiptDigest, deliveryDecisionPath, deliveryDecisionDigest, deliveryApprovalEvidenceManifestPath, deliveryApprovalEvidenceManifestDigest, deliveryVerificationReceiptPath, deliveryVerificationReceiptDigest, transferFixtureResultDigest }`とし、`unitResultDigest`はこの10-path result集合を閉じ、inner genesisはdiskのserializer evidence、base approval、support／delivery owner decision、delivery approval evidence manifest／exact 12 envelope、timebox receipt、両verification receiptをstrict再検証して同digestを投影する。`run-pre-i0`とcoordinatorはactual comparison-base／support／delivery decisionに対して各shared verifier libraryを必ず呼び、unit assertionだけ、既存verification receiptの再利用、calibration／approval verifierを別途実行してPRE 1成功へ合成することを拒否する。

PRE inner genesisとouter `PRE-FSMC-ENTRY-001`は§6.1のexact shapeどおり`comparisonBaseSha`／approval、serializer rewire path／digest、adopted policy、`dbAuthorityAvailabilityDecisionDigest = null`、timebox、support owner decision＋verification receipt、delivery seed decision＋verification receiptを持ち、全10 commandのresolved argv、baseline `git-diff-check` result、outer seal bindingへ同じbase SHAを投影する。baseはapproved decisionとbyte一致するcandidateのdistinct ancestor、lowercase full SHAでなければならない。inner／outerはまだ存在しないactual reforecast／bundle／graph／handoffのpathまたはdigestを持たない。absolute source pathはlocal resolver監査以外のdigest preimageにせず、outer seal後に`reforecast:fsmc:delivery -- --trigger-kind scheduled --trigger-id PRE`をseed-only A0／manifest digest／latest refとfresh receipt／next bundle outputを明示してworkspace外fresh pathへexact 1回実行する。その後、fresh A1をB1へbyte-preserving copyしてfresh C1へmaterialize／verifyし、pre-entry outer＋A1 delivery-authority manifestのexact 2 root receipt bundleとbundle外`PRE-FSMC-HANDOFF-001`を生成する。reforecastはauthority manifest末尾からreachable objectとして解決する。post-seal bundleはbase approval、serializer evidence、support decision／verification、delivery seed／verification／reforecastもreachable closureへ含める。I0-A Entryはreceipt bundleのouter／authority manifest／handoff／coordinator result exact 4入力とC1 bundle root／manifest digest／latest logical refのexact 3 bindingをfresh Cのbundle resolverだけで検証し、object／authority／trust／source／digest差、reforecast `featureAdmission != "go"`ではgrant 0件とする。

共通`ESP-JSON-V1-001` authority／cross-runtime golden、format hygiene、approved `PRE-FSMC-BASE-001`／`PRE-FSMC-SUPPORT-001`／`PRE-FSMC-DELIVERY-001`、phase外`PRE-FSMC-VCAP-001`、PRE-owned I0 Entry toolを完結した同一clean candidateで、`PRE 1/2 test:fsmc:pre-i0-foundation`→`PRE 2/2 verify:fsmc:db-version-provenance --require-adopted`→repository baseline 8 commandの順に実行する。`selectionStatus = adopted`／availability available、ledger owner／channel set／source snapshot／distribution trust root／completeness approval digest、DB owner registry／owner trust root／exact 2 authority evidence digest、policy digest、serializer source／golden raw digest＋rewire evidence、fixed A constants blob／抽出値digest、`same-profile-qualification-required | handoff-only` selection、comparison-base authority／decision digest、support owner decision／verification、delivery owner seed／verificationを記録する。blocked／unknown／authority-unavailableを手動で上書きせず、`same-profile-supported`をPRE recordへ書かない。recordは実行中のworktreeをdirtyにしないworkspace外local pathへ保存し、10 command全成功とouter seal後に同じattemptでseed-only A0→PRE reforecast＋fresh A1→A1/B1/C1 authority bundle→outer＋A1 manifestのactual exact-2-root receipt bundle A→B→fresh C→handoffをPREだけが生成・検証し、その成功後だけPR本文へ転記する。以下のPowerShell blockは最終topologyのnormative target templateであり、列挙したtracked path／package actionが存在しない`reviewedHead`では実行可能な手順でも合格証跡でもない。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcWorktreeStatus = @(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)
$fsmcStatusExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($fsmcStatusExitCode -ne 0 -or $fsmcWorktreeStatus.Count -ne 0) {
  throw "pre-I0 requires a clean worktree before PRE 1/2"
}
$fsmcCandidateSha = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $fsmcCandidateSha) { throw "cannot resolve pre-I0 candidate SHA" }
$fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "docs/verification/fsmc/comparison-base-approval.json" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcComparisonBaseApproval = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($fsmcComparisonBaseApproval.status -ne "approved" -or $fsmcComparisonBaseApproval.decisionId -ne "PRE-FSMC-BASE-001") {
  throw "comparison base approval must be the approved PRE-FSMC-BASE-001 decision"
}
$fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalDigest = [string] $fsmcComparisonBaseApproval.decisionDigest
if ($fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') {
  throw "comparison base approval decision digest must be lowercase SHA-256"
}
$fsmcComparisonBaseRef = "$([string] $fsmcComparisonBaseApproval.comparisonBaseSha)^{commit}"
$fsmcComparisonBaseSha = (git rev-parse $fsmcComparisonBaseRef).Trim().ToLowerInvariant()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $fsmcComparisonBaseSha -notmatch '^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$') {
  throw "cannot resolve approved pre-I0 comparison base SHA"
}
$fsmcCandidateSha = $fsmcCandidateSha.ToLowerInvariant()
if ($fsmcCandidateSha -notmatch '^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$' -or $fsmcComparisonBaseSha -eq $fsmcCandidateSha) {
  throw "pre-I0 requires distinct full base and candidate SHAs"
}
git merge-base --is-ancestor $fsmcComparisonBaseSha $fsmcCandidateSha
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "approved comparison base must be an ancestor of candidate" }
git diff --check $fsmcComparisonBaseSha $fsmcCandidateSha --
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "base-to-candidate diff check failed" }
$fsmcGitTopLevel = (git rev-parse --show-toplevel).Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $fsmcGitTopLevel) { throw "cannot resolve repository root" }
$fsmcRepositoryRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcGitTopLevel).TrimEnd([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)
$fsmcCurrentRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-Location).Path).TrimEnd([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)
if ($fsmcCurrentRoot -ne $fsmcRepositoryRoot) {
  throw "run the pre-I0 block from the canonical repository root"
}

$fsmcPreI0ResultDir = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-i0-result-directory>")
$fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-i0-entry-receipt-path>")
$fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisPath = "$fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath.inner-genesis.json"
$fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisStagingPath = "$fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisPath.runner-staged"
$fsmcPreI0OuterReceiptStagingPath = "$fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath.outer-staged"
$fsmcWorkspaceRoot = $fsmcRepositoryRoot + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar

function Test-FsmcPathWithin {
  param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Root, [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Candidate)
  $fsmcRelative = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($Root, $Candidate)
  return $fsmcRelative -eq "." -or (
    -not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($fsmcRelative) -and
    $fsmcRelative -ne ".." -and
    -not $fsmcRelative.StartsWith("..$([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)", [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
  )
}

function Assert-FsmcNoReparseParent {
  param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path)
  $fsmcCursor = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $Path) -Force -ErrorAction Stop
  while ($null -ne $fsmcCursor) {
    if (($fsmcCursor.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) {
      throw "pre-I0 output parent chain must not contain a reparse point"
    }
    $fsmcCursor = $fsmcCursor.Parent
  }
}

$fsmcPreI0ExternalPaths = @(
  $fsmcPreI0ResultDir,
  $fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath,
  $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisPath,
  $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisStagingPath,
  $fsmcPreI0OuterReceiptStagingPath
)
foreach ($fsmcExternalPath in $fsmcPreI0ExternalPaths) {
  if (Test-FsmcPathWithin $fsmcWorkspaceRoot $fsmcExternalPath) {
    throw "pre-I0 records must be outside the workspace"
  }
  Assert-FsmcNoReparseParent $fsmcExternalPath
}
for ($fsmcLeft = 0; $fsmcLeft -lt $fsmcPreI0ExternalPaths.Count; $fsmcLeft++) {
  for ($fsmcRight = $fsmcLeft + 1; $fsmcRight -lt $fsmcPreI0ExternalPaths.Count; $fsmcRight++) {
    if (
      (Test-FsmcPathWithin $fsmcPreI0ExternalPaths[$fsmcLeft] $fsmcPreI0ExternalPaths[$fsmcRight]) -or
      (Test-FsmcPathWithin $fsmcPreI0ExternalPaths[$fsmcRight] $fsmcPreI0ExternalPaths[$fsmcLeft])
    ) { throw "pre-I0 output paths must be pairwise distinct and non-containing" }
  }
}
foreach ($fsmcFreshPath in $fsmcPreI0ExternalPaths) {
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcFreshPath) { throw "pre-I0 requires fresh non-existing paths" }
  $fsmcFreshParent = Split-Path -Parent $fsmcFreshPath
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcFreshParent -PathType Container)) {
    throw "pre-I0 output parents must already exist"
  }
}
if (
  [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisPath) -ne [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisStagingPath) -or
  [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath) -ne [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($fsmcPreI0OuterReceiptStagingPath)
) { throw "pre-I0 atomic publish paths must stay on the same volume" }

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcPwshCommand = (Get-Command pwsh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
$fsmcNodeCommand = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
$fsmcStartInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
$fsmcStartInfo.FileName = $fsmcPwshCommand
$fsmcStartInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
$fsmcStartInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
$fsmcPreI0Args = @(
  "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-File", $fsmcFormalActionCommand,
  "run", "run:fsmc:pre-i0", "--",
  "--base-sha", $fsmcComparisonBaseSha,
  "--comparison-base-approval", $fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalPath,
  "--comparison-base-approval-digest", $fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalDigest,
  "--candidate-sha", $fsmcCandidateSha,
  "--result-dir", $fsmcPreI0ResultDir,
  "--receipt-staging-out", $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisStagingPath,
  "--internal-deadline-ms", "1170000"
)
foreach ($fsmcArg in $fsmcPreI0Args) { [void] $fsmcStartInfo.ArgumentList.Add($fsmcArg) }

$fsmcPreI0Stopwatch = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
$fsmcPreI0Process = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($fsmcStartInfo)
$fsmcPreI0KillError = $null
$fsmcPreI0Completed = $fsmcPreI0Process.WaitForExit(1175000)
$fsmcPreI0Terminated = $fsmcPreI0Completed
if (-not $fsmcPreI0Completed) {
  try {
    if (-not $fsmcPreI0Process.HasExited) { $fsmcPreI0Process.Kill($true) }
  } catch {
    $fsmcPreI0KillError = $_.Exception.Message
  }
  $fsmcRemainingShutdownMs = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(5000, [int](1180000 - $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds)))
  $fsmcPreI0Terminated = $fsmcRemainingShutdownMs -gt 0 -and $fsmcPreI0Process.WaitForExit($fsmcRemainingShutdownMs)
}
$fsmcPreI0ExitCode = if ($fsmcPreI0Completed -and $fsmcPreI0Process.HasExited) { $fsmcPreI0Process.ExitCode } else { -1 }
$fsmcPreI0RunnerSucceeded =
  $fsmcPreI0Completed -and
  $fsmcPreI0Terminated -and
  $fsmcPreI0ExitCode -eq 0 -and
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisStagingPath -PathType Leaf) -and
  -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisPath) -and
  -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath)

$fsmcPreI0ReceiptVerified = $false
if ($fsmcPreI0RunnerSucceeded) {
  $fsmcVerifyInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
  $fsmcVerifyInfo.FileName = $fsmcPwshCommand
  $fsmcVerifyInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
  $fsmcVerifyInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
  $fsmcVerifyArgs = @(
    "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-File", $fsmcFormalActionCommand,
    "run", "verify:fsmc:db-version-provenance", "--",
    "--verify-pre-i0-entry", $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisStagingPath,
    "--result-dir", $fsmcPreI0ResultDir,
    "--base-sha", $fsmcComparisonBaseSha,
    "--comparison-base-approval", $fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalPath,
    "--comparison-base-approval-digest", $fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalDigest,
    "--candidate-sha", $fsmcCandidateSha
  )
  foreach ($fsmcArg in $fsmcVerifyArgs) { [void] $fsmcVerifyInfo.ArgumentList.Add($fsmcArg) }
  $fsmcVerifyProcess = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($fsmcVerifyInfo)
  $fsmcVerifyWaitMs = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(9000, [int](1189000 - $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds)))
  $fsmcVerifyCompleted = $fsmcVerifyWaitMs -gt 0 -and $fsmcVerifyProcess.WaitForExit($fsmcVerifyWaitMs)
  if (-not $fsmcVerifyCompleted) {
    try { if (-not $fsmcVerifyProcess.HasExited) { $fsmcVerifyProcess.Kill($true) } } catch { }
    $fsmcVerifyShutdownMs = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(1000, [int](1190000 - $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds)))
    if ($fsmcVerifyShutdownMs -gt 0 -and -not $fsmcVerifyProcess.HasExited) {
      [void] $fsmcVerifyProcess.WaitForExit($fsmcVerifyShutdownMs)
    }
  }
  $fsmcPreI0ReceiptVerified = $fsmcVerifyCompleted -and $fsmcVerifyProcess.ExitCode -eq 0
}

$fsmcPreI0Valid = $false
$fsmcPreI0OuterAdmittedAtMs = $null
$fsmcPreI0OuterCommitStartedAtMs = $null
$fsmcOuterSealStarted = $false
$fsmcOuterSealCompleted = $false
$fsmcOuterSealTerminated = $false
$fsmcOuterSealExitCode = -1
$fsmcOuterSealKillError = $null
if ($fsmcPreI0ReceiptVerified -and $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds -le 1189000) {
  [IO.File]::Move($fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisStagingPath, $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisPath)
  $fsmcPreI0OuterAdmittedAtMs = $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds
  if ($fsmcPreI0OuterAdmittedAtMs -le 1189000) {
    $fsmcPreI0RegistryPath = Join-Path $fsmcRepositoryRoot "config/fsmc-pre-i0-commands.json"
    $fsmcPreI0Registry = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0RegistryPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    $fsmcOuterSealSpec = $fsmcPreI0Registry.outerSealSpec
    if (
      $fsmcOuterSealSpec.logicalPackageAction -ne "record:fsmc:pre-i0-entry" -or
      $fsmcOuterSealSpec.action -ne "seal-outer-acceptance" -or
      $fsmcOuterSealSpec.executable -ne "node" -or
      $fsmcOuterSealSpec.cwd -ne "." -or
      $fsmcOuterSealSpec.timeoutMs -ne 5000 -or
      -not $fsmcOuterSealSpec.outerSealSpecDigest
    ) { throw "pre-I0 outer seal registry spec is invalid" }

    $fsmcOuterSealBindings = @{
      baseSha = $fsmcComparisonBaseSha
      comparisonBaseApproval = $fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalPath
      comparisonBaseApprovalDigest = $fsmcComparisonBaseApprovalDigest
      candidateSha = $fsmcCandidateSha
      resultDir = $fsmcPreI0ResultDir
      innerGenesis = $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisPath
      outerSealBudgetMs = "5000"
      receiptStagingOut = $fsmcPreI0OuterReceiptStagingPath
    }
    $fsmcOuterSealArgs = @(
      foreach ($fsmcTemplateArg in @($fsmcOuterSealSpec.argvTemplate)) {
        $fsmcTemplateText = [string]$fsmcTemplateArg
        if ($fsmcTemplateText -match '^\{([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)\}$') {
          $fsmcBindingName = $Matches[1]
          if (-not $fsmcOuterSealBindings.ContainsKey($fsmcBindingName)) {
            throw "unknown pre-I0 outer seal argv placeholder: $fsmcBindingName"
          }
          [string]$fsmcOuterSealBindings[$fsmcBindingName]
        } elseif ($fsmcTemplateText.Contains("{") -or $fsmcTemplateText.Contains("}")) {
          throw "mixed or malformed pre-I0 outer seal argv placeholder"
        } else {
          $fsmcTemplateText
        }
      }
    )
    $fsmcOuterSealExecutable = (Get-Command ([string]$fsmcOuterSealSpec.executable) -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop).Source
    $fsmcOuterSealCwd = $fsmcRepositoryRoot
    $fsmcOuterSealInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
    $fsmcOuterSealInfo.FileName = $fsmcOuterSealExecutable
    $fsmcOuterSealInfo.WorkingDirectory = $fsmcOuterSealCwd
    $fsmcOuterSealInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
    $fsmcOuterSealInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
    $fsmcOuterSealInfo.Environment.Clear()
    foreach ($fsmcEnvironmentKey in @($fsmcOuterSealSpec.environmentAllowlist)) {
      $fsmcEnvironmentValue = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable([string]$fsmcEnvironmentKey, "Process")
      if ($null -eq $fsmcEnvironmentValue) {
        throw "missing allowlisted pre-I0 outer seal environment value: $fsmcEnvironmentKey"
      }
      $fsmcOuterSealInfo.Environment[[string]$fsmcEnvironmentKey] = $fsmcEnvironmentValue
    }
    foreach ($fsmcArg in $fsmcOuterSealArgs) { [void] $fsmcOuterSealInfo.ArgumentList.Add($fsmcArg) }
    $fsmcOuterSealWaitMs = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(5000, [int](1195000 - $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds)))
    if ($fsmcOuterSealWaitMs -gt 0) {
      $fsmcOuterSealProcess = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($fsmcOuterSealInfo)
      $fsmcOuterSealStarted = $true
      $fsmcOuterSealCompleted = $fsmcOuterSealProcess.WaitForExit($fsmcOuterSealWaitMs)
      $fsmcOuterSealTerminated = $fsmcOuterSealCompleted
      if (-not $fsmcOuterSealCompleted) {
        try {
          if (-not $fsmcOuterSealProcess.HasExited) { $fsmcOuterSealProcess.Kill($true) }
        } catch {
          $fsmcOuterSealKillError = $_.Exception.Message
        }
        $fsmcOuterSealShutdownMs = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(1000, [int](1196000 - $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds)))
        $fsmcOuterSealTerminated =
          $fsmcOuterSealShutdownMs -gt 0 -and
          $fsmcOuterSealProcess.WaitForExit($fsmcOuterSealShutdownMs)
      }
      if ($fsmcOuterSealCompleted -and $fsmcOuterSealProcess.HasExited) {
        $fsmcOuterSealExitCode = $fsmcOuterSealProcess.ExitCode
      }
    }
  }
}

if (
  $fsmcOuterSealStarted -and
  $fsmcOuterSealCompleted -and
  $fsmcOuterSealTerminated -and
  $fsmcOuterSealExitCode -eq 0 -and
  $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds -le 1195000 -and
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisPath -PathType Leaf) -and
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0OuterReceiptStagingPath -PathType Leaf) -and
  -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath)
) {
  $fsmcPreI0OuterCommitStartedAtMs = $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds
  if ($fsmcPreI0OuterCommitStartedAtMs -le 1195000) {
    [IO.File]::Move($fsmcPreI0OuterReceiptStagingPath, $fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath)
    $fsmcPreI0Valid = Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath -PathType Leaf
  }
}

if (-not $fsmcPreI0Valid -and $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds -lt 1198000) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0ResultDir)) {
    [void](New-Item -ItemType Directory -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0ResultDir)
  }
  $fsmcOuterDiagnosticPath = Join-Path $fsmcPreI0ResultDir "outer-guard-diagnostic.json"
  $fsmcOuterDiagnosticTemp = "$fsmcOuterDiagnosticPath.tmp-$([Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))"
  $fsmcOuterDiagnostic = [ordered]@{
    schemaVersion = 1
    candidateSha = $fsmcCandidateSha
    runnerCompleted = $fsmcPreI0Completed
    runnerTerminated = $fsmcPreI0Terminated
    runnerExitCode = $fsmcPreI0ExitCode
    receiptVerified = $fsmcPreI0ReceiptVerified
    innerGenesisStagingPresent = Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisStagingPath -PathType Leaf
    innerGenesisPresent = Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0InnerGenesisPath -PathType Leaf
    outerReceiptStagingPresent = Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0OuterReceiptStagingPath -PathType Leaf
    finalReceiptPresent = Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath -PathType Leaf
    outerAdmittedAtElapsedMs = $fsmcPreI0OuterAdmittedAtMs
    outerCommitStartedAtElapsedMs = $fsmcPreI0OuterCommitStartedAtMs
    outerSealStarted = $fsmcOuterSealStarted
    outerSealCompleted = $fsmcOuterSealCompleted
    outerSealTerminated = $fsmcOuterSealTerminated
    outerSealExitCode = $fsmcOuterSealExitCode
    elapsedMs = $fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds
    runnerKillError = $fsmcPreI0KillError
    outerSealKillError = $fsmcOuterSealKillError
  } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
  $fsmcOuterDiagnostic | Set-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcOuterDiagnosticTemp -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline
  [IO.File]::Move($fsmcOuterDiagnosticTemp, $fsmcOuterDiagnosticPath)
}
$fsmcPreI0Stopwatch.Stop()
if (-not $fsmcPreI0Valid) {
  throw "pre-I0 failed or missed its outer acceptance schedule; final receipt was not accepted: $fsmcPreI0KillError"
}
```

final outer seal後のactual transferは、上のblockと同じPowerShell processで次を実行する。delivery reforecast、delivery authority A0／A1／B1／C1、receipt bundle A／B／C、2 verification、handoff、coordinator resultの12 output pathはすべて開始時不存在、workspace外、pairwise distinct／非包含、reparse parentなしとし、outer guardとcoordinatorがfirst write前に二重検証する。正規3 ownerが承認したreforecast inputは既存workspace外read-only fileとして別に渡す。`run:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff`はtracked seed＋verification＋`--delivery-approval-evidence-manifest`のtracked exact-12 closure→seed-only A0 initialize→PRE receipt seal＋fresh A1 append→A1 byte-preserving B1 copy→fresh C1 materialize／verify→outer＋A1 manifest exact-2-root receipt bundle export→adapter-owned A→B copy／verify→fresh C import→local resolver禁止C verify→handoff seal→handoff verifyを単一monotonic internal deadline 55秒で順にexact 1回実行する。`run:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff`は明示`--delivery-approval-evidence-manifest`と`--timebox-calibration-receipt`をstrict検証し、そのcandidate、12 output role、coordinator command spec digest／script blob OID、handoff verifier spec digest／script blob OID、55,000／60,000 ms cap、topology digestがcurrent実装へ一致し、calibrationのinternal／outer実測が各cap以下の場合だけ開始する。PRE timebox calibrationは同じ12-output topologyを測り、55秒へ収まらなければhandoffをNo-Goとしてdelivery reforecastし、計測なしにtimeoutを延長しない。外側はcoordinator setup／wait／最大1秒のprocess-tree kill／canonical result commit後のfresh direct-`node.exe` handoff verifier／そのkill・reapを単一60秒deadlineで共有する。coordinator完了・exit 0、verifier exit 0、reforecast／C1 manifest／canonical result／handoff存在、resultのresolved invocation＝handoff、topology＝timebox、handoffにsealしたverifier executable／full argv／cwd／exact environment＝actual `ProcessStartInfo`、shared verifierによるhandoff-verifier resolved invocation digest／output manifest／result self-digest再計算、outer elapsed 60秒以下を全て満たした場合だけhandoffをacceptedとする。deadline後に残ったreforecast／authority bundle／receipt bundle／handoff／preparedまたはfinal-result stagingはunaccepted partialであり、削除や手動採用をせず、次回は全pathをfreshにしてPRE 10 commandからやり直す。`Get-FileHash`はlogical ref導出用にfinal outer raw bytesを読むだけで、bundle resolverの代替にはしない。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcPreHandoffStopwatch = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
$fsmcPreTimeboxCalibrationReceipt = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-existing-pre-timebox-calibration-receipt-path>")
$fsmcPreDeliveryApprovalEvidenceManifest = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "docs/verification/fsmc/delivery-approval-evidence/manifest.json" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcPreDeliveryReforecastInput = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-existing-owner-approved-pre-reforecast-input>")
$fsmcPreDeliveryReforecastPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-delivery-reforecast-path>")
$fsmcPreAuthoritySeedBundleA0 = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-seed-only-authority-bundle-a0>")
$fsmcPreAuthorityBundleA1 = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-authority-bundle-a1>")
$fsmcPreAuthorityBundleB1 = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-authority-bundle-b1>")
$fsmcPreAuthorityBundleC1 = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-authority-bundle-c1>")
$fsmcPreBundleRootA = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-bundle-root-a>")
$fsmcPreBundleRootB = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-bundle-root-b>")
$fsmcPreImportedRootC = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-import-root-c>")
$fsmcPreBundleVerifyB = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-bundle-b-verification-path>")
$fsmcPreTransferVerifyC = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-transfer-c-verification-path>")
$fsmcPreHandoffPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-handoff-path>")
$fsmcPreHandoffResultPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-handoff-result-path>")
$fsmcPreEntryDigest = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if ($fsmcPreEntryDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw "cannot derive final PRE entry digest" }
$fsmcPreEntryLogicalRef = "fsmc-evidence-v1/pre-entry/$fsmcPreEntryDigest"
$fsmcPreExistingInputs = @($fsmcPreTimeboxCalibrationReceipt, $fsmcPreDeliveryReforecastInput)
foreach ($fsmcPreExistingInput in $fsmcPreExistingInputs) {
  if (
    (Test-FsmcPathWithin $fsmcWorkspaceRoot $fsmcPreExistingInput) -or
    -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreExistingInput -PathType Leaf)
  ) { throw "PRE handoff input must be an existing workspace-external owner file" }
  if (((Get-Item -LiteralPath $fsmcPreExistingInput -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) {
    throw "PRE handoff input leaf must not be a reparse point"
  }
  Assert-FsmcNoReparseParent $fsmcPreExistingInput
}

$fsmcPreHandoffPaths = @(
  $fsmcPreDeliveryReforecastPath,
  $fsmcPreAuthoritySeedBundleA0,
  $fsmcPreAuthorityBundleA1,
  $fsmcPreAuthorityBundleB1,
  $fsmcPreAuthorityBundleC1,
  $fsmcPreBundleRootA,
  $fsmcPreBundleRootB,
  $fsmcPreImportedRootC,
  $fsmcPreBundleVerifyB,
  $fsmcPreTransferVerifyC,
  $fsmcPreHandoffPath,
  $fsmcPreHandoffResultPath
)
foreach ($fsmcExternalPath in $fsmcPreHandoffPaths) {
  if (Test-FsmcPathWithin $fsmcWorkspaceRoot $fsmcExternalPath) { throw "PRE handoff paths must be outside the workspace" }
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcExternalPath) { throw "PRE handoff paths must be fresh" }
  Assert-FsmcNoReparseParent $fsmcExternalPath
}
for ($fsmcLeft = 0; $fsmcLeft -lt $fsmcPreHandoffPaths.Count; $fsmcLeft++) {
  for ($fsmcRight = $fsmcLeft + 1; $fsmcRight -lt $fsmcPreHandoffPaths.Count; $fsmcRight++) {
    if (
      (Test-FsmcPathWithin $fsmcPreHandoffPaths[$fsmcLeft] $fsmcPreHandoffPaths[$fsmcRight]) -or
      (Test-FsmcPathWithin $fsmcPreHandoffPaths[$fsmcRight] $fsmcPreHandoffPaths[$fsmcLeft])
    ) { throw "PRE handoff paths must be pairwise distinct and non-containing" }
  }
}

$fsmcPreHandoffPackageJson = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcRepositoryRoot "package.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
$fsmcPreCheckpointRegistry = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcRepositoryRoot "config/fsmc-checkpoints.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
$fsmcPreHandoffActionProperty = $fsmcPreHandoffPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties["run:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff"]
$fsmcPreHandoffVerifierActionProperty = $fsmcPreHandoffPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties["verify:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff"]

$fsmcPreHandoffVerifierScriptBlobOid = (git rev-parse ("{0}:{1}" -f $fsmcCandidateSha, "scripts/fsmc/receipt-transfer-bundle.mjs")).Trim()

  $null -eq $fsmcPreHandoffActionProperty -or

  $null -ne $fsmcPreHandoffPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties["postrun:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff"] -or

  $fsmcPreHandoffSpec.executable -cne "node" -or
  $fsmcPreHandoffSpec.scriptPath -cne "scripts/fsmc/run-pre-i0-handoff.mjs" -or
  $fsmcPreHandoffSpec.cwd -cne "." -or

  $fsmcPreHandoffSpec.outerHardCapMs -ne 60000 -or

  [string]::Join("`n", @($fsmcPreHandoffSpec.environmentAllowlist)) -cne [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcPreExpectedEnvironmentKeys) -or
  $fsmcPreHandoffVerifierSpec.logicalPackageAction -cne "verify:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff" -or

  $fsmcPreHandoffVerifierSpec.scriptPath -cne "scripts/fsmc/receipt-transfer-bundle.mjs" -or
  $fsmcPreHandoffVerifierSpec.scriptBlobOid -cne $fsmcPreHandoffVerifierScriptBlobOid -or
  $fsmcPreHandoffVerifierSpec.cwd -cne "." -or

  entryReceipt = $fsmcPreI0ReceiptPath

$fsmcPreOuterVerifierAccepted = $false

if (

  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreHandoffResultPath -PathType Leaf)
) {
  $fsmcPreOuterVerifierInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
  $fsmcPreOuterVerifierInfo.FileName = $fsmcNodeCommand

  $fsmcPreOuterVerifierEnvironmentAccepted =

    [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcPreExpectedEnvironmentKeys)
  if ($fsmcPreOuterVerifierEnvironmentAccepted) {

    $fsmcPreOuterHandoffDocument.preI0PackageLifecycleHookPolicy -cne "forbid-pre-post" -or

}
$fsmcPreExpectedOutputRoles = @(

)
$fsmcPreExpectedOutputPaths = @(

  $fsmcPreAuthorityBundleB1,
  $fsmcPreAuthorityBundleC1,

  $fsmcPreImportedRootC,

)
$fsmcPreExpectedOutputKinds = @(
  "json-file",
  "bundle-root",
  "bundle-root",
  "bundle-root",
  "bundle-root",
  "bundle-root",
  "bundle-root",
  "bundle-root",
  "json-file",
  "json-file",
  "json-file"

if ($fsmcPreResolvedEnvironmentAccepted) {

  if ([string]::Join("`n", $fsmcPreResolvedEnvironmentKeys) -cne [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcPreExpectedEnvironmentKeys)) {

  } else {

$fsmcPreHandoffAccepted =
  $fsmcPreOuterVerifierAccepted -and
  $fsmcPreHandoffCompleted -and
  $fsmcPreHandoffProcess.ExitCode -eq 0 -and
  $fsmcPreHandoffStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds -le $fsmcPreHandoffSpec.outerHardCapMs -and

  $fsmcPreHandoffResult.resolvedCwd -ceq $fsmcRepositoryRoot -and
  $fsmcPreHandoffResult.resolvedInvocationDigest -ceq $fsmcPreHandoff.transferResolvedInvocationDigest -and

  $fsmcPreHandoffResult.durationMs -le 55000 -and

  $fsmcPreHandoffResult.handoffCanonicalPath -ceq $fsmcPreHandoffPath -and
  $fsmcPreHandoffResult.handoffDigest -ceq $fsmcPreHandoff.handoffDigest -and

  $fsmcPreHandoffResult.resultDigest -match '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

```

`run:fsmc:pre-i0`は`config/fsmc-pre-i0-commands.json`のexact PRE 2→baseline 8順を唯一の実行authorityとし、shell commandや任意argvを受けない。各inner childも同registryの`formalActionExecutionSpecs`から実targetを解決してabsolute `node.exe`／`pwsh.exe`へ直接spawnし、npm／package manager shellを起動しない。PRE 1は上記coordinatorのactual child集合とoutput digestを1 command resultへ封じ、別processで事後合成しない。単一monotonic internal deadlineから各childのremaining timeoutを導出し、unit→integration→Workerを直列実行して別Vitest poolを同時起動しない。child non-zero／timeout／signal時はdescendant process treeまで終了し、そのcommand ID／spec／full resolved invocation preimage、exit／signal、duration、candidate SHA／clean statusをfresh result directoryへno-clobber atomic保存してからfail-fastするため、Node管理下の失敗診断は必ず残る。unit invocation内部も対象除外、`passWithNoTests`、retry、timeout waiverなしでprocess exit 0を要求する。PRE 2 commandは`Sequence: PRE 1/2`～`2/2`、baseline 8 commandは`BASE 1/8`～`8/8`の個別recordを同じcandidate SHAへ残す。runnerの最後は検証10 commandへ数えないinner genesis sealだけであり、adopted decisionと10 resultのexact集合から`PRE-FSMC-INNER-GENESIS-001`をinner sibling stagingへ作る。外側guardは別process verifier成功後にこれをcanonical inner pathへatomic renameし、registryの`outerSealSpec`からだけ導出した`record:fsmc:pre-i0-entry --action seal-outer-acceptance`を起動して`PRE-FSMC-ENTRY-001` outer envelopeをouter sibling stagingへ作らせる。result directory、inner／outer staging、inner／final receipt pathは開始時に存在しないattempt固有pathだけを許可し、全fileはtemporary childからno-clobber atomic renameする。runner／outer sealerは担当child handleのclose、開始時刻、deadline、result／inner genesis、remaining timeout、final cleanを検証してから各stagingをpublishし、失敗／timeout時はaccepted final receipt 0件とする。PRE reforecast、actual transfer bundle、handoff、coordinator resultはouter seal後の別stageだけが生成し、10-command inner deadlineまたはouter receipt preimageへ含めない。

Node runnerは1,170秒でchild cleanup／diagnostic／inner genesis staging sealを完了し、外側PowerShellは1,175秒で通常waitを打ち切り、process tree kill＋終了確認を最大5秒に制限する。runner exit 0の場合だけ、monotonic 1,189秒までの最大9秒で同じPRE verifierを別processとして起動し、inner staging／10 result／candidate SHA／final clean／deadline／full invocation preimageをstrict再検証する。検証済みinnerをcanonical pathへrenameした後、guard内elapsedが1,189,000以下の場合だけouter sealerを起動するが、そのcaller elapsedをsealer argv／receiptへ渡さない。outer sealerはregistry固定specで最大5秒、外側guardはsealer exit 0とouter stagingを確認してmonotonic 1,195秒以下でfinal envelopeのatomic commitを開始する。1,189秒と1,195秒はsupported guardの運用cutoff／SLOであり、durable Entry acceptance fieldではない。Move後に可視化したimmutable finalを再判定／削除しない。1,200秒はprocess wait／kill／diagnostic開始の運用目標であって、OS filesystem callのwall-clock終了を保証するhard capとは呼ばない。I0-Aはinner genesisにsealedされたrunner-owned `totalDurationMs <= internalDeadlineMs = 1170000`、`outerSealDurationMs <= 5000`、inner／spec digestに加え、post-seal bundle／handoff／coordinator resultのstrict schema、self-digest、fresh-C graph equality、outer object digestをdurable authorityとして判定し、guardだけが観測した1,189／1,195秒SLOを事後の合否へ使わない。外側はcutoff後に無制限の`git` commandを起動せず、runner／outer sealer／bounded verifierがSHA／cleanを所有する。sealer admission前またはouter commit開始前のhang、kill、non-zero、verifier failureではsupported flowのaccepted final receiptを残さず、予約済み`outer-guard-diagnostic.json`をfresh result directoryへbounded no-clobber保存する。残ったpartial result／inner／outer stagingは診断専用で、manual Moveをsupported guard timing evidenceとはみなさない。I0-A Entry verifierはPRE-owned schema、bundle外handoff／coordinator result、fresh Cのbundle resolverが辿るouter→inner→10 result／projection／invocation preimage、internal deadline／total duration、outer seal／全command specをread-only再検証する。失敗後は同じまたは新しいclean candidateでも必ず新attempt／全fresh pathでPRE 2＋baseline 8＋post-seal handoffを最初から再実行し、旧attemptの部分成功、assertion通過だけ、参考実行を流用しない。外部observerやcredential確認は行わない。

### 通常PR

I0-Aは`test:fsmc:runners:bootstrap`で`run-bootstrap.test.mjs`を含むactive 3 Node fileをdirect pre-Entry commandとしてexact 1回だけ実行・記録し、同じI0-A candidateへEntry検証後のbootstrapを実行する。I0-Bはこのself-testを再実行せずI0-A receiptからrunner trustを継承し、checkpointを`FSMC-I0-B`、parentをI0-A Exit receipt、result directoryを新しいempty external directory、receipt outputを新しいexternal pathへすべて切り替えてEntry→bootstrap→Exitを実行する。

直後のhelper fenceを通常PR sessionの単独開始blockとし、そこから「checkpoint-exit verifier」完了までに並ぶ後続exact 7 fenceを同じPowerShell processのcontinuation chainとする。間の説明文や見出しはsession境界ではなく、全8 fenceを表示順にだけ実行する。後続7 fenceの単独copy、別session再開、順序変更を禁止し、record wrapperのnon-zeroを親shellでも直後にthrowして失敗後のcommandやExit sealerへ進まない。Exit verifier fenceの終了でこのsession範囲を閉じ、その後に本文が別processと指定するscheduled delivery blockへhelper／変数を継承しない。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path

function Assert-FsmcExitCode {
  param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Name, [Parameter(Mandatory)] [int] $ExitCode)
  if ($ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "$Name failed with exit $ExitCode" }
}

function Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand {
  param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $CommandId,
    [string[]] $Bindings = @(),
    [string] $CommandInstanceId = $CommandId
  )
  $fsmcWrapperArgs = @(
    "run", "run:fsmc:checkpoint-command", "--",
    "--checkpoint", $fsmcCheckpoint,
    "--candidate-sha", $fsmcCandidateSha,
    "--result-dir", $fsmcResultDir,
    "--command-id", $CommandId,
    "--command-instance-id", $CommandInstanceId
  )
  foreach ($fsmcBinding in $Bindings) {
    $fsmcWrapperArgs += @("--binding", $fsmcBinding)
  }
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand @fsmcWrapperArgs
  $fsmcRecordedExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
  Assert-FsmcExitCode $CommandId $fsmcRecordedExitCode
  $fsmcRecordedResultPath = Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "$CommandInstanceId.json"
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcRecordedResultPath -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw "$CommandId did not create its canonical result"
  }
  $fsmcEntryGrantPath = Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "entry-grant.json"
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-result -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --command-id $CommandId --command-instance-id $CommandInstanceId --entry-grant $fsmcEntryGrantPath --result $fsmcRecordedResultPath
  Assert-FsmcExitCode "$CommandId result-verifier" $LASTEXITCODE
  $fsmcRecordedResult = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcRecordedResultPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
  if (
    $fsmcRecordedResult.commandId -ne $CommandId -or
    $fsmcRecordedResult.commandInstanceId -ne $CommandInstanceId -or
    $fsmcRecordedResult.exitCode -ne 0
  ) {
    throw "$CommandId returned an invalid canonical result"
  }
  $fsmcEntryGrant = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcEntryGrantPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
  if (
    $fsmcRecordedResult.attemptId -ne $fsmcEntryGrant.attemptId -or
    $fsmcRecordedResult.entryGrantDigest -ne $fsmcEntryGrant.entryGrantDigest -or
    $null -eq $fsmcRecordedResult.outputs -or
    -not $fsmcRecordedResult.resultDigest
  ) { throw "$CommandId result did not bind the active attempt, grant, outputs, and digest" }
  $script:fsmcLastRecordedResult = $fsmcRecordedResult
}

function Invoke-FsmcRecordedParallelPair {
  param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $LeftCommandId,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $RightCommandId
  )
  if (
    $LeftCommandId -ne "encoding" -or
    $RightCommandId -ne "typecheck" -or
    $LeftCommandId -eq $RightCommandId
  ) { throw "the critical parallel stage is exact ordered [encoding, typecheck]" }

  $fsmcParallelArgs = @(
    "run", "run:fsmc:checkpoint-parallel-stage", "--",
    "--checkpoint", $fsmcCheckpoint,
    "--candidate-sha", $fsmcCandidateSha,
    "--result-dir", $fsmcResultDir,
    "--left-command-id", $LeftCommandId,
    "--right-command-id", $RightCommandId
  )
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand @fsmcParallelArgs
  Assert-FsmcExitCode "encoding-typecheck parallel stage" $LASTEXITCODE

  $fsmcParallelResults = @()
  foreach ($fsmcCommandId in @($LeftCommandId, $RightCommandId)) {
    $fsmcResultPath = Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "$fsmcCommandId.json"
    $fsmcEntryGrantPath = Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "entry-grant.json"
    & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-result -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --command-id $fsmcCommandId --command-instance-id $fsmcCommandId --entry-grant $fsmcEntryGrantPath --result $fsmcResultPath
    Assert-FsmcExitCode "$fsmcCommandId parallel result-verifier" $LASTEXITCODE
    $fsmcResult = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcResultPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    if (
      $fsmcResult.commandId -ne $fsmcCommandId -or
      $fsmcResult.commandInstanceId -ne $fsmcCommandId -or
      $fsmcResult.exitCode -ne 0
    ) { throw "$fsmcCommandId parallel result is invalid" }
    $fsmcParallelResults += $fsmcResult
  }
  $script:fsmcLastParallelRecordedResults = $fsmcParallelResults
}
```

`run:fsmc:checkpoint-parallel-stage`はregistryが宣言するordered exact `["encoding", "typecheck"]`だけを受ける非recorded schedulerで、同じEntry grantをread-only検証し、相異なるcommand instance／result pathを予約して両`run-command` processを開始してからどちらかをwaitする。schedulerと各`run-command`は同じ`formalActionExecutionSpecs`／launcher digestを再検証し、各child targetをdirect `node.exe`／`pwsh.exe`で起動してnpm／package manager shellを介さない。最大並列2、retry 0であり、一方のfailure／timeout／signal時は他方のprocess treeをterminate／reapして両resultを確定し、stageはnon-zeroを返す。両canonical resultが存在し、それぞれのresolved invocation／result verifierが成功した場合だけstage exit 0とする。scheduler自身のsummary／checkpoint command rowは作らず、Exit sealerはencoding／typecheckの2 resultを別々にexact照合するため、critical path算術だけをmax値、実行証跡は2 commandとして維持する。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcGitTopLevel = (git rev-parse --show-toplevel).Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $fsmcGitTopLevel) { throw "cannot resolve repository root" }
$fsmcRepositoryRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcGitTopLevel).TrimEnd([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)
$fsmcCurrentRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-Location).Path).TrimEnd([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)
if ($fsmcCurrentRoot -ne $fsmcRepositoryRoot) { throw "run the I0-A block from the canonical repository root" }
$fsmcWorkspaceRoot = $fsmcRepositoryRoot + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
$fsmcGitCommand = (Get-Command git.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcNodeCommand = (Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source

function Test-FsmcPathWithin {
  param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Root, [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Candidate)
  $fsmcRelative = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($Root, $Candidate)
  return $fsmcRelative -eq "." -or (
    -not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($fsmcRelative) -and
    $fsmcRelative -ne ".." -and
    -not $fsmcRelative.StartsWith("..$([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)", [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
  )
}

function Assert-FsmcNoReparseParent {
  param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path)
  $fsmcCursor = Get-Item -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $Path) -Force -ErrorAction Stop
  while ($null -ne $fsmcCursor) {
    if (($fsmcCursor.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) {
      throw "I0-A input/output parent chain must not contain a reparse point"
    }
    $fsmcCursor = $fsmcCursor.Parent
  }
}

function Assert-FsmcCandidateCleanAndFiles {
  param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string[]] $RepoRelativePaths)
  $fsmcStatusInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
  $fsmcStatusInfo.FileName = $fsmcGitCommand
  $fsmcStatusInfo.WorkingDirectory = $fsmcRepositoryRoot
  $fsmcStatusInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
  $fsmcStatusInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
  $fsmcStatusInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
  $fsmcStatusInfo.RedirectStandardError = $true
  foreach ($fsmcStatusArg in @("status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")) {
    [void] $fsmcStatusInfo.ArgumentList.Add($fsmcStatusArg)
  }
  $fsmcStatusProcess = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($fsmcStatusInfo)
  $fsmcStatusBytes = $fsmcStatusProcess.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()
  $fsmcStatusError = $fsmcStatusProcess.StandardError.ReadToEnd()
  $fsmcStatusProcess.WaitForExit()
  if ($fsmcStatusProcess.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $fsmcStatusBytes.Length -ne 0) {
    throw "I0-A pre-Entry requires an exact clean candidate: $fsmcStatusError"
  }
  foreach ($fsmcRepoRelativePath in $RepoRelativePaths) {
    $fsmcCandidateBlobOid = (& $fsmcGitCommand rev-parse ("{0}:{1}" -f $fsmcCandidateSha, $fsmcRepoRelativePath)).Trim()
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $fsmcCandidateBlobOid -notmatch '^([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$') {
      throw "cannot resolve candidate blob: $fsmcRepoRelativePath"
    }
    $fsmcDiskBlobOid = (& $fsmcGitCommand hash-object --no-filters -- $fsmcRepoRelativePath).Trim()
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $fsmcDiskBlobOid -cne $fsmcCandidateBlobOid) {
      throw "disk bytes differ from candidate blob: $fsmcRepoRelativePath"
    }
  }
}

$fsmcBaseSha = "<PRE-FSMC-BASE-001.comparisonBaseSha bound by parent receipt>"
$fsmcCheckpoint = "FSMC-I0-A"
$fsmcCandidateSha = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$fsmcParentBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-copied-pre-bundle-root-b>")
$fsmcParentImportedRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-pre-import-root-c>")
$fsmcParentHandoff = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-pre-handoff-path>")
$fsmcParentHandoffResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-pre-handoff-result-path>")
$fsmcDeliveryReforecastReceipt = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-PRE-delivery-reforecast-receipt-path>")
$fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-PRE-delivery-authority-bundle-c1>")
$fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys = @("COMSPEC", "PATH", "PATHEXT", "SYSTEMROOT", "TEMP", "TMP")
foreach ($fsmcParentAuthorityLeaf in @($fsmcParentHandoff, $fsmcParentHandoffResult)) {
  if (
    (Test-FsmcPathWithin $fsmcWorkspaceRoot $fsmcParentAuthorityLeaf) -or
    -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcParentAuthorityLeaf -PathType Leaf)
  ) { throw "I0-A handoff authority must be an existing workspace-external leaf" }
  if (((Get-Item -LiteralPath $fsmcParentAuthorityLeaf -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) {
    throw "I0-A handoff authority leaf must not be a reparse point"
  }
  Assert-FsmcNoReparseParent $fsmcParentAuthorityLeaf
}
$fsmcParentHandoffRawBefore = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $fsmcParentHandoff -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$fsmcParentHandoffResultRawBefore = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $fsmcParentHandoffResult -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
Assert-FsmcCandidateCleanAndFiles @("config/fsmc-pre-i0-commands.json", "config/fsmc-pre-i0-commands.schema.json", "config/fsmc-checkpoints.json", "config/fsmc-checkpoints.schema.json", "package.json", "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1", "scripts/fsmc/receipt-transfer-bundle.mjs")
$fsmcParentHandoffDocument = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcParentHandoff -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
$fsmcPreHandoffRegistry = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcRepositoryRoot "config/fsmc-pre-i0-commands.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
$fsmcCheckpointHandoffRegistry = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcRepositoryRoot "config/fsmc-checkpoints.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
$fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec = $fsmcPreHandoffRegistry.handoffVerifierSpec
$fsmcPreEntryPackageJson = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcRepositoryRoot "package.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
$fsmcHandoffVerifierPackageAction = $fsmcPreEntryPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties["verify:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff"].Value
$fsmcHandoffVerifierScriptBlobOid = (git rev-parse ("{0}:{1}" -f $fsmcCandidateSha, "scripts/fsmc/receipt-transfer-bundle.mjs")).Trim()
if (
  $LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or
  $fsmcHandoffVerifierScriptBlobOid -notmatch '^([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$' -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.candidateSha -cne $fsmcCandidateSha -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.checkpointPreEntryCommandSpecDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.preCommandRegistryDigest -cne $fsmcPreHandoffRegistry.commandRegistryDigest -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.checkpointRegistryDigest -cne $fsmcCheckpointHandoffRegistry.registryDigest -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.preI0PackageLifecycleHookPolicy -cne "forbid-pre-post" -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.checkpointPackageLifecycleHookPolicy -cne "forbid-pre-post" -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.preFormalActionLauncherSpecDigest -cne $fsmcPreHandoffRegistry.commands[0].formalActionLauncherSpecDigest -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.checkpointFormalActionLauncherSpecDigest -cne $fsmcCheckpointHandoffRegistry.formalActionLauncherSpecDigest -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.formalPackageLifecycleVerificationDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierLogicalPackageAction -cne "verify:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff" -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierScriptPath -cne "scripts/fsmc/receipt-transfer-bundle.mjs" -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierScriptBlobOid -cne $fsmcHandoffVerifierScriptBlobOid -or
  $fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.logicalPackageAction -cne "verify:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff" -or
  $fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.executable -cne "node" -or
  $fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.scriptPath -cne "scripts/fsmc/receipt-transfer-bundle.mjs" -or
  $fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.scriptBlobOid -cne $fsmcHandoffVerifierScriptBlobOid -or
  $fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.cwd -cne "." -or
  $fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.specDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or
  @($fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.environmentAllowlist).Count -ne $fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys.Count -or
  [string]::Join("`n", @($fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.environmentAllowlist)) -cne [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys) -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierSpecDigest -cne $fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.specDigest -or
  $fsmcHandoffVerifierPackageAction -cne "node scripts/fsmc/receipt-transfer-bundle.mjs --action verify-pre-i0-handoff" -or
  $null -ne $fsmcPreEntryPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties["preverify:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff"] -or
  $null -ne $fsmcPreEntryPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties["postverify:fsmc:pre-i0-handoff"]
) { throw "I0-A handoff verifier is not pinned by the PRE authority" }
$fsmcHandoffVerifierBindings = [ordered]@{
  handoff = $fsmcParentHandoff
  result = $fsmcParentHandoffResult
}
$fsmcHandoffVerifierArgv = @(
  foreach ($fsmcTemplateArgValue in @($fsmcHandoffVerifierSpec.argvTemplate)) {
    $fsmcTemplateArg = [string] $fsmcTemplateArgValue
    if ($fsmcTemplateArg -match "^\{([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)\}$") {
      $fsmcBindingName = $Matches[1]
      if (-not $fsmcHandoffVerifierBindings.Contains($fsmcBindingName)) { throw "unbound I0-A handoff verifier placeholder: $fsmcBindingName" }
      [string] $fsmcHandoffVerifierBindings[$fsmcBindingName]
    } elseif ($fsmcTemplateArg.Contains("{") -or $fsmcTemplateArg.Contains("}")) {
      throw "invalid I0-A handoff verifier placeholder"
    } else {
      $fsmcTemplateArg
    }
  }
)
$fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
$fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo.FileName = $fsmcNodeCommand
$fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo.WorkingDirectory = $fsmcRepositoryRoot
$fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
$fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
$fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo.Environment.Clear()
foreach ($fsmcEnvironmentKey in $fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys) {
  $fsmcEnvironmentValue = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($fsmcEnvironmentKey, [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Process)
  if ($null -eq $fsmcEnvironmentValue) { throw "missing I0-A handoff-verifier environment value: $fsmcEnvironmentKey" }
  $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo.Environment[$fsmcEnvironmentKey] = $fsmcEnvironmentValue
}
$fsmcParentHandoffVerifierEnvironmentAccepted =
  [string]::Join("`n", @($fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierResolvedEnvironment.PSObject.Properties.Name)) -ceq
  [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys)
if ($fsmcParentHandoffVerifierEnvironmentAccepted) {
  foreach ($fsmcEnvironmentKey in $fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys) {
    if ([string] $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierResolvedEnvironment.$fsmcEnvironmentKey -cne [string] $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo.Environment[$fsmcEnvironmentKey]) {
      $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierEnvironmentAccepted = $false
      break
    }
  }
}
if (
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierResolvedExecutable -cne $fsmcNodeCommand -or
  [string]::Join("`n", @($fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierResolvedArgv)) -cne [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcHandoffVerifierArgv) -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierResolvedCwd -cne $fsmcRepositoryRoot -or
  -not $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierEnvironmentAccepted -or
  $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.handoffVerifierResolvedInvocationDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
) { throw "I0-A handoff does not bind the actual verifier ProcessStartInfo" }
foreach ($fsmcArg in $fsmcHandoffVerifierArgv) {
  [void] $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo.ArgumentList.Add($fsmcArg)
}
Assert-FsmcCandidateCleanAndFiles @("config/fsmc-pre-i0-commands.json", "config/fsmc-pre-i0-commands.schema.json", "config/fsmc-checkpoints.json", "config/fsmc-checkpoints.schema.json", "package.json", "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1", "scripts/fsmc/receipt-transfer-bundle.mjs")
$fsmcParentHandoffVerifierProcess = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($fsmcParentHandoffVerifierInfo)
$fsmcParentHandoffVerifierCompleted = $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierProcess.WaitForExit(60000)
if (-not $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierCompleted) {
  try { if (-not $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierProcess.HasExited) { $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierProcess.Kill($true) } } catch { }
  if (-not $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierProcess.HasExited -and -not $fsmcParentHandoffVerifierProcess.WaitForExit(5000)) {
    throw "I0-A handoff verifier process tree did not terminate after timeout"
  }
  throw "I0-A handoff verifier exceeded 60000 ms"
}
if ($fsmcParentHandoffVerifierProcess.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "I0-A handoff verifier rejected the parent authority" }
if (
  (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $fsmcParentHandoff -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -cne $fsmcParentHandoffRawBefore -or
  (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $fsmcParentHandoffResult -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -cne $fsmcParentHandoffResultRawBefore
) { throw "I0-A handoff verifier changed its read-only inputs" }
$fsmcDeliveryAuthorityManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcParentLogicalRef = "fsmc-evidence-v1/pre-entry/<lowercase-outer-raw-sha256>"
$fsmcPreEntryResultDir = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-pre-entry-result-directory>")
$fsmcPreEntryResult = Join-Path $fsmcPreEntryResultDir "run-bootstrap-self-test.json"
$fsmcResultDir = "<workspace-external-new-command-result-directory>"
$fsmcReceiptOut = "<workspace-external-new-checkpoint-receipt-path>"
$fsmcCheckpointRegistry = $fsmcCheckpointHandoffRegistry
function Assert-FsmcFormalPackageLifecyclePolicy {
  Assert-FsmcCandidateCleanAndFiles @("config/fsmc-checkpoints.json", "package.json")
  $fsmcCurrentPackageJson = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcRepositoryRoot "package.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
  if (
    $fsmcCheckpointRegistry.packageLifecycleHookPolicy -cne "forbid-pre-post" -or
    @($fsmcCheckpointRegistry.formalLogicalPackageActions).Count -eq 0
  ) { throw "checkpoint package lifecycle policy is not closed" }
  $fsmcFormalPackageActionNames = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::Ordinal)
  foreach ($fsmcFormalPackageActionValue in @($fsmcCheckpointRegistry.formalLogicalPackageActions)) {
    $fsmcFormalPackageAction = [string] $fsmcFormalPackageActionValue
    if (
      -not $fsmcFormalPackageActionNames.Add($fsmcFormalPackageAction) -or
      $null -eq $fsmcCurrentPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties[$fsmcFormalPackageAction] -or
      $null -ne $fsmcCurrentPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties["pre$fsmcFormalPackageAction"] -or
      $null -ne $fsmcCurrentPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties["post$fsmcFormalPackageAction"]
    ) { throw "formal package action is missing, duplicated, or lifecycle-hooked: $fsmcFormalPackageAction" }
  }
}
Assert-FsmcFormalPackageLifecyclePolicy
$fsmcBootstrapSpec = $fsmcCheckpointRegistry.preEntryCommandSpec
$fsmcBootstrapExpectedArgvTemplate = @(
  "scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-receipt.mjs", "--action", "run-bootstrap-self-test",
  "--checkpoint", "FSMC-I0-A",
  "--candidate-sha", "{candidateSha}",
  "--result-dir", "{preEntryResultDir}"
)
$fsmcBootstrapExpectedNodeTestPaths = @(
  "scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-receipt.test.mjs",
  "scripts/fsmc/run-bootstrap.test.mjs",
  "scripts/fsmc/verify-change-surface.test.mjs"
)
$fsmcPackageJson = $fsmcPreEntryPackageJson
$fsmcBootstrapPackageAction = $fsmcPackageJson.scripts.PSObject.Properties[$fsmcBootstrapSpec.logicalPackageAction].Value
$fsmcBootstrapScriptBlobOid = (git rev-parse ("{0}:{1}" -f $fsmcCandidateSha, $fsmcBootstrapSpec.scriptPath)).Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $fsmcBootstrapScriptBlobOid -notmatch '^([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$') {
  throw "cannot resolve I0-A pre-Entry script blob"
}
if (
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.checkpointId -cne "FSMC-I0-A" -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.commandId -cne "run-bootstrap-self-test" -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.logicalPackageAction -cne "test:fsmc:runners:bootstrap" -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.executable -cne "node" -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.scriptPath -cne "scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-receipt.mjs" -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.cwd -cne "." -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.timeoutMs -ne 180000 -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.resultFileName -cne "run-bootstrap-self-test.json" -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.scriptBlobOid -cne $fsmcBootstrapScriptBlobOid -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.commandSpecDigest -cne $fsmcParentHandoffDocument.checkpointPreEntryCommandSpecDigest -or
  $fsmcBootstrapSpec.commandSpecDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or
  $fsmcBootstrapPackageAction -cne "node scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-receipt.mjs --action run-bootstrap-self-test" -or
  [string]::Join("`n", @($fsmcBootstrapSpec.argvTemplate)) -cne [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcBootstrapExpectedArgvTemplate) -or
  [string]::Join("`n", @($fsmcBootstrapSpec.nodeTestPaths)) -cne [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcBootstrapExpectedNodeTestPaths) -or
  [string]::Join("`n", @($fsmcBootstrapSpec.environmentAllowlist)) -cne [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys)
) { throw "I0-A pre-Entry command spec does not match the closed contract" }
$fsmcBootstrapBindings = [ordered]@{
  candidateSha = $fsmcCandidateSha
  preEntryResultDir = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcPreEntryResultDir)
}
if (
  (Test-FsmcPathWithin $fsmcWorkspaceRoot $fsmcPreEntryResultDir) -or
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreEntryResultDir)
) { throw "I0-A pre-Entry result directory must be fresh and workspace-external" }
Assert-FsmcNoReparseParent $fsmcPreEntryResultDir
$fsmcBootstrapArgv = @(
  foreach ($fsmcTemplateArgValue in @($fsmcBootstrapSpec.argvTemplate)) {
    $fsmcTemplateArg = [string] $fsmcTemplateArgValue
    if ($fsmcTemplateArg -match "^\{([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)\}$") {
      $fsmcBindingName = $Matches[1]
      if (-not $fsmcBootstrapBindings.Contains($fsmcBindingName)) { throw "unbound I0-A pre-Entry argv placeholder: $fsmcBindingName" }
      [string] $fsmcBootstrapBindings[$fsmcBindingName]
    } elseif ($fsmcTemplateArg.Contains("{") -or $fsmcTemplateArg.Contains("}")) {
      throw "invalid I0-A pre-Entry argv placeholder"
    } else {
      $fsmcTemplateArg
    }
  }
)
$fsmcBootstrapInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
$fsmcBootstrapInfo.FileName = $fsmcNodeCommand
$fsmcBootstrapInfo.WorkingDirectory = $fsmcRepositoryRoot
$fsmcBootstrapInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
$fsmcBootstrapInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
$fsmcBootstrapInfo.Environment.Clear()
foreach ($fsmcEnvironmentKey in $fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys) {
  $fsmcEnvironmentValue = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($fsmcEnvironmentKey, [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Process)
  if ($null -eq $fsmcEnvironmentValue) { throw "missing I0-A pre-Entry environment value: $fsmcEnvironmentKey" }
  $fsmcBootstrapInfo.Environment[$fsmcEnvironmentKey] = $fsmcEnvironmentValue
}
foreach ($fsmcArg in $fsmcBootstrapArgv) { [void] $fsmcBootstrapInfo.ArgumentList.Add($fsmcArg) }
Assert-FsmcCandidateCleanAndFiles @(
  "config/fsmc-checkpoints.json",
  "package.json",
  "scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-receipt.mjs",
  "scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-receipt.test.mjs",
  "scripts/fsmc/run-bootstrap.test.mjs",
  "scripts/fsmc/verify-change-surface.test.mjs"
)
$fsmcBootstrapStopwatch = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
$fsmcBootstrapProcess = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($fsmcBootstrapInfo)
$fsmcBootstrapCompleted = $fsmcBootstrapProcess.WaitForExit($fsmcBootstrapSpec.timeoutMs)
if (-not $fsmcBootstrapCompleted) {
  try { if (-not $fsmcBootstrapProcess.HasExited) { $fsmcBootstrapProcess.Kill($true) } } catch { }
  if (-not $fsmcBootstrapProcess.HasExited -and -not $fsmcBootstrapProcess.WaitForExit(5000)) {
    throw "I0-A pre-Entry process tree did not terminate after timeout"
  }
  throw "I0-A pre-Entry self-test exceeded its 180000 ms deadline"
}
$fsmcBootstrapStopwatch.Stop()
if (
  $fsmcBootstrapProcess.ExitCode -ne 0 -or
  $fsmcBootstrapStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds -gt $fsmcBootstrapSpec.timeoutMs -or
  -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPreEntryResult -PathType Leaf)
) { throw "I0-A pre-Entry self-test was not accepted" }
Assert-FsmcCandidateCleanAndFiles @(
  "config/fsmc-checkpoints.json",
  "package.json",
  "scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-receipt.mjs",
  "scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-receipt.test.mjs",
  "scripts/fsmc/run-bootstrap.test.mjs",
  "scripts/fsmc/verify-change-surface.test.mjs"
)
if (((Get-Item -LiteralPath $fsmcPreEntryResult -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) {
  throw "I0-A pre-Entry result leaf must not be a reparse point"
}
Assert-FsmcNoReparseParent $fsmcPreEntryResult
$fsmcBootstrapResult = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcPreEntryResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 100
$fsmcBootstrapResultEnvironmentAccepted =
  [string]::Join("`n", @($fsmcBootstrapResult.resolvedEnvironment.PSObject.Properties.Name)) -ceq [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys)
if ($fsmcBootstrapResultEnvironmentAccepted) {
  foreach ($fsmcEnvironmentKey in $fsmcBootstrapExpectedEnvironmentKeys) {
    if ([string] $fsmcBootstrapResult.resolvedEnvironment.$fsmcEnvironmentKey -cne [string] $fsmcBootstrapInfo.Environment[$fsmcEnvironmentKey]) {
      $fsmcBootstrapResultEnvironmentAccepted = $false
      break
    }
  }
}
$fsmcBootstrapNodeTestsAccepted = @($fsmcBootstrapResult.nodeTests).Count -eq 3
if ($fsmcBootstrapNodeTestsAccepted) {
  for ($fsmcBootstrapTestIndex = 0; $fsmcBootstrapTestIndex -lt 3; $fsmcBootstrapTestIndex++) {
    $fsmcBootstrapTest = $fsmcBootstrapResult.nodeTests[$fsmcBootstrapTestIndex]
    if (
      $fsmcBootstrapTest.path -cne $fsmcBootstrapSpec.nodeTestPaths[$fsmcBootstrapTestIndex] -or
      $fsmcBootstrapTest.exitCode -ne 0 -or
      $null -ne $fsmcBootstrapTest.signal -or
      $fsmcBootstrapTest.durationMs -lt 0
    ) { $fsmcBootstrapNodeTestsAccepted = $false; break }
  }
}
if (
  $fsmcBootstrapResult.commandId -cne "run-bootstrap-self-test" -or
  $fsmcBootstrapResult.commandSpecDigest -cne $fsmcBootstrapSpec.commandSpecDigest -or
  $fsmcBootstrapResult.candidateSha -cne $fsmcCandidateSha -or
  $fsmcBootstrapResult.resolvedExecutable -cne $fsmcNodeCommand -or
  [string]::Join("`n", @($fsmcBootstrapResult.resolvedArgv)) -cne [string]::Join("`n", $fsmcBootstrapArgv) -or
  $fsmcBootstrapResult.resolvedCwd -cne $fsmcRepositoryRoot -or
  -not $fsmcBootstrapResultEnvironmentAccepted -or
  $fsmcBootstrapResult.resolvedInvocationDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or
  -not $fsmcBootstrapNodeTestsAccepted -or
  $fsmcBootstrapResult.totalDurationMs -lt 0 -or
  $fsmcBootstrapResult.totalDurationMs -gt $fsmcBootstrapSpec.timeoutMs -or
  $fsmcBootstrapResult.resultDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
) { throw "I0-A pre-Entry result does not match its command spec" }
Assert-FsmcFormalPackageLifecyclePolicy
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-entry -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --parent-bundle $fsmcParentBundle --parent-imported-root $fsmcParentImportedRoot --parent-logical-ref $fsmcParentLogicalRef --parent-handoff $fsmcParentHandoff --parent-handoff-result $fsmcParentHandoffResult --deny-local-parent-resolver --delivery-authority-bundle $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle --expected-delivery-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityManifest.manifestDigest --delivery-authority-latest-ref $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityManifest.latestLogicalRef --delivery-reforecast-receipt $fsmcDeliveryReforecastReceipt --pre-entry-result $fsmcPreEntryResult --result-dir $fsmcResultDir --receipt-out $fsmcReceiptOut
Assert-FsmcExitCode "checkpoint-entry" $LASTEXITCODE
Assert-FsmcFormalPackageLifecyclePolicy
Invoke-FsmcRecordedParallelPair "encoding" "typecheck"
Assert-FsmcFormalPackageLifecyclePolicy
Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand "bootstrap" @("baseSha=$fsmcBaseSha", "checkpoint=$fsmcCheckpoint")
Assert-FsmcFormalPackageLifecyclePolicy
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run record:fsmc:checkpoint-exit -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --parent-bundle $fsmcParentBundle --parent-imported-root $fsmcParentImportedRoot --parent-logical-ref $fsmcParentLogicalRef --parent-handoff $fsmcParentHandoff --parent-handoff-result $fsmcParentHandoffResult --deny-local-parent-resolver --result-dir $fsmcResultDir --receipt-out $fsmcReceiptOut
Assert-FsmcExitCode "checkpoint-exit" $LASTEXITCODE
Assert-FsmcFormalPackageLifecyclePolicy
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-exit -- --receipt $fsmcReceiptOut
Assert-FsmcExitCode "checkpoint-exit verifier" $LASTEXITCODE
```

I0-Bは上記I0-A parent profile全体（`--parent-bundle --parent-imported-root --parent-logical-ref --parent-handoff --parent-handoff-result --deny-local-parent-resolver --pre-entry-result`）とdirect `run-bootstrap-self-test`／pre-Entry directoryを除き、代わりにexact `--parent-receipt <I0-A Exit receipt>`をEntry／Exitへ渡す。I0-B専用の開始時不存在result directory／receipt pathを使い、以後もI0-A専用optionとの混在を拒否する。I0-C～I10およびI11-Aは次のfull gateを実行する。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcBaseSha = "<PRE-FSMC-BASE-001.comparisonBaseSha bound by parent receipt>"
$fsmcPhase = "FSMC-I<n>"
$fsmcCheckpoint = "FSMC-I<n>[-A|-B|-C]"
$fsmcCandidateSha = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$fsmcParentReceipt = "<workspace-external-parent-receipt-path>"
$fsmcDeliveryReforecastReceipt = "<workspace-external-latest-delivery-reforecast-receipt-path>"
$fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle = "<workspace-external-latest-delivery-authority-bundle-root>"
$fsmcDeliveryAuthorityManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcResultDir = "<workspace-external-new-command-result-directory>"
$fsmcReceiptOut = "<workspace-external-new-checkpoint-receipt-path>"
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-entry -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --parent-receipt $fsmcParentReceipt --delivery-authority-bundle $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle --expected-delivery-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityManifest.manifestDigest --delivery-authority-latest-ref $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityManifest.latestLogicalRef --delivery-reforecast-receipt $fsmcDeliveryReforecastReceipt --result-dir $fsmcResultDir --receipt-out $fsmcReceiptOut
Assert-FsmcExitCode "checkpoint-entry" $LASTEXITCODE
Invoke-FsmcRecordedParallelPair "encoding" "typecheck"
Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand "quick" @("baseSha=$fsmcBaseSha", "phase=$fsmcPhase")
```

通常PRではUI変更時。各owner phaseで初めてactiveになるB row／variantは差分heuristicにかかわらず必須。ただしregistryが`release-calibration-stage`を要求するcheckpointではcalibrationが同じactive browser集合を所有し、このstandalone commandを実行しない。I0-Cのexact 5-context probeも同stage outputsが唯一のauthorityである:

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand "browser-smoke" @("phase=$fsmcPhase")
```

通常PRでは性能影響時。各calibration owner phaseで初めてactiveになるP rowは差分heuristicにかかわらず必須:

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand "performance-smoke" @("phase=$fsmcPhase")
```

I0-C、I2-C、I10 Exit、I11-Aは対応stageのrelease calibrationも実行し、canonical receiptを更新する。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcCalibrationArtifactRecord = "<workspace-external-new-nonexistent-calibration-artifact-record-output-path>"
$fsmcCalibrationReceipt = "<workspace-external-new-nonexistent-calibration-receipt-output-path>"
$fsmcCalibrationRoot = "<workspace-external-new-nonexistent-calibration-artifact-root-path>"
$fsmcCalibrationStage = "<FSMC-I0-C|FSMC-I2-C|FSMC-I10|FSMC-I11-A>"
Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand "release-calibration-stage" @("stage=$fsmcCalibrationStage", "baseSha=$fsmcBaseSha", "artifactRoot=$fsmcCalibrationRoot", "artifactRecordOut=$fsmcCalibrationArtifactRecord", "receiptOut=$fsmcCalibrationReceipt")
```

I4／I8／I10のowner Formal Exit、またはregistryが列挙するcanonical closureの差により`qualificationSurfaceDigest`が変化した場合だけ、対応QMAXを別枠（Backup／Map 10分、Route 2分）でexact 1回実行する:

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcScaleQualificationId = "<QMAX-BACKUP-01|QMAX-MAP-01|QMAX-ROUTE-01>"
$fsmcScaleInstanceId = "scale-qualification--$fsmcScaleQualificationId"
$fsmcScaleReceipt = "<workspace-external-scale-qualification-receipt-path>"
Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand "scale-qualification" @("qualificationId=$fsmcScaleQualificationId", "phase=$fsmcPhase", "receiptOut=$fsmcScaleReceipt") -CommandInstanceId $fsmcScaleInstanceId
```

上記のうち`config/fsmc-checkpoints.json`が当該checkpointへ要求するcommandをすべて記録した後だけExitをsealする。未該当browser／performance／calibration／QMAXのresultを余分に置くことも、必須resultを省くことも失敗とする。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run record:fsmc:checkpoint-exit -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --parent-receipt $fsmcParentReceipt --result-dir $fsmcResultDir --receipt-out $fsmcReceiptOut
Assert-FsmcExitCode "checkpoint-exit" $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-exit -- --receipt $fsmcReceiptOut
Assert-FsmcExitCode "checkpoint-exit verifier" $LASTEXITCODE
```

scheduled triggerを所有するfinal Exit（I0／I4／I8／I10／I11-A／I11-B）またはverified initial provider distributionの直後は、次のblockを別processでexact 1回実行する。I11-BではExit verifier成功後・release admission export前、`PROVIDER-DISTRIBUTED`ではinitial terminal receipt import検証後・local provider binding CAS前である。approval inputは3 ownerがexact payloadへ署名した既存workspace外file、outputは開始時不存在のworkspace外pathとし、receiptが`no-go`でも上書きせずrecovery chainへ進む。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDeliveryScheduledTrigger = "<I0|I4|I8|I10|I11-A|I11-B|PROVIDER-DISTRIBUTED>"
$fsmcDeliveryScheduledTriggerEvidence = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<verified-trigger-evidence-path>")
$fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthority = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<tracked-seed-or-latest-workspace-external-reforecast-path>")
$fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<verified-previous-delivery-authority-bundle-root>")
$fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundleDigest = "<verified-previous-manifest-digest>"
$fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityLatestRef = "<verified-previous-latest-logical-ref>"
$fsmcDeliveryApprovalInput = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<existing-workspace-external-owner-approved-input-path>")
$fsmcNextDeliveryReforecast = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-workspace-external-delivery-reforecast-path>")
$fsmcNextDeliveryAuthorityBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-workspace-external-next-delivery-authority-bundle-root>")
$fsmcAllowedScheduledTriggers = @("I0", "I4", "I8", "I10", "I11-A", "I11-B", "PROVIDER-DISTRIBUTED")
if ($fsmcDeliveryScheduledTrigger -notin $fsmcAllowedScheduledTriggers) { throw "invalid scheduled delivery trigger" }
if (
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcNextDeliveryReforecast) -or
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcNextDeliveryAuthorityBundle)
) { throw "delivery reforecast receipt and next authority bundle outputs must both be fresh" }
$fsmcDeliveryArgs = @(
  "run", "reforecast:fsmc:delivery", "--",
  "--trigger-kind", "scheduled",
  "--trigger-id", $fsmcDeliveryScheduledTrigger,
  "--trigger-evidence", $fsmcDeliveryScheduledTriggerEvidence,
  "--previous-authority-bundle", $fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle,
  "--expected-previous-authority-bundle-digest", $fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundleDigest,
  "--previous-authority-latest-ref", $fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityLatestRef,
  "--previous-authority", $fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthority,
  "--approval-input", $fsmcDeliveryApprovalInput,
  "--receipt-out", $fsmcNextDeliveryReforecast,
  "--next-authority-bundle-out", $fsmcNextDeliveryAuthorityBundle
)
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand @fsmcDeliveryArgs | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "scheduled delivery reforecast failed" }
$fsmcNextDeliveryManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcNextDeliveryAuthorityBundle "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:delivery-reforecast -- --authority-bundle $fsmcNextDeliveryAuthorityBundle --expected-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcNextDeliveryManifest.manifestDigest --authority-latest-ref $fsmcNextDeliveryManifest.latestLogicalRef --expected-latest-authority $fsmcNextDeliveryReforecast | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "scheduled delivery reforecast verifier failed" }
$fsmcDeliveryReforecastReceipt = $fsmcNextDeliveryReforecast
$fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle = $fsmcNextDeliveryAuthorityBundle
$fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundleDigest = [string] $fsmcNextDeliveryManifest.manifestDigest
$fsmcDeliveryAuthorityLatestRef = [string] $fsmcNextDeliveryManifest.latestLogicalRef
```

formal command failure、calibration／qualification failure、terminal receipt前のimport済みprovider operation failure、またはscheduled receiptの`featureAdmission = "no-go"`後は、修正実装を始める前にownerがscope／limit／capacity decisionを作り、次のrecovery blockを別processで実行する。failure resultとprevious authority bundleはread-only、approval inputは3 global owner＋affected product ownerが同じpayloadを承認した既存fileである。scheduled no-goではそのscheduled receipt自体をfailure result、scheduled output bundleをprevious authority bundleとし、checkpoint／attemptはtrigger evidence、command IDは`delivery-reforecast:<scheduled-trigger-id>`、reasonは`scheduled-reforecast-withheld`へ固定する。成功receiptがgoでもformal command failureの旧attemptを再開せず、fresh result／receipt pathの新Entryへ`$fsmcRecoveryReforecastOut`をexplicitに渡す。ただしpost-I11-B／PROVIDER-DISTRIBUTED scheduled no-goは実装attemptの失敗ではないため、同じverified Exit／provider terminal receiptを保持し、latest recovery headをそれぞれadmission／initial bindのexplicit inputへ渡して再開する。 provider failureではprevious authority bundleを最新post-I11 bundle、failure resultをverified `FsmcProviderOperationFailureResultV1`、reasonを`provider-operation-failure`に固定し、terminal receiptを捏造せずfresh provider runだけを再試行する。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcFailedCheckpoint = "<FSMC-Ix[-A|-B|-C]|PROVIDER-DISTRIBUTION>"
$fsmcFailedAttempt = "<failed-attempt-id>"
$fsmcFailedCommand = "<failed-command-id>"
$fsmcRecoveryReason = "<correctness-failure|calibration-overrun|qualification-failure|provider-operation-failure|scheduled-reforecast-withheld>"
$fsmcFailedResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-command-scheduled-or-provider-failure-result-path>")
$fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthority = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<latest-workspace-external-delivery-reforecast-path>")
$fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<verified-previous-delivery-authority-bundle-root>")
$fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundleDigest = "<verified-previous-manifest-digest>"
$fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityLatestRef = "<verified-previous-latest-logical-ref>"
$fsmcRecoveryApprovalInput = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<existing-workspace-external-recovery-approval-input-path>")
$fsmcRecoveryReforecastOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-workspace-external-recovery-reforecast-path>")
$fsmcRecoveryAuthorityBundleOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-workspace-external-recovery-authority-bundle-root>")
$fsmcExternalEvidence = if ($fsmcRecoveryReason -in @("calibration-overrun", "qualification-failure")) {
  [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<matching-calibration-or-qualification-receipt-path>")
} else {
  $null
}
if (
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcRecoveryReforecastOut) -or
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcRecoveryAuthorityBundleOut)
) { throw "recovery receipt and next authority bundle outputs must both be fresh" }
$fsmcRecoveryArgs = @(
  "run", "reforecast:fsmc:delivery", "--",
  "--trigger-kind", "recovery",
  "--failed-checkpoint", $fsmcFailedCheckpoint,
  "--failed-attempt", $fsmcFailedAttempt,
  "--failed-command", $fsmcFailedCommand,
  "--reason-code", $fsmcRecoveryReason,
  "--failure-result", $fsmcFailedResult,
```
