```powershell
  "--previous-authority-bundle", $fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle,
  "--expected-previous-authority-bundle-digest", $fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundleDigest,
  "--previous-authority-latest-ref", $fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthorityLatestRef,
  "--previous-authority", $fsmcPreviousDeliveryAuthority,
  "--approval-input", $fsmcRecoveryApprovalInput,
  "--receipt-out", $fsmcRecoveryReforecastOut,
  "--next-authority-bundle-out", $fsmcRecoveryAuthorityBundleOut
)
if ($null -ne $fsmcExternalEvidence) {
  $fsmcRecoveryArgs += @("--external-evidence", $fsmcExternalEvidence)
}
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand @fsmcRecoveryArgs | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "delivery recovery reforecast failed" }
$fsmcRecoveryManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcRecoveryAuthorityBundleOut "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:delivery-reforecast -- --authority-bundle $fsmcRecoveryAuthorityBundleOut --expected-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcRecoveryManifest.manifestDigest --authority-latest-ref $fsmcRecoveryManifest.latestLogicalRef --expected-latest-authority $fsmcRecoveryReforecastOut | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "delivery recovery reforecast is not verified" }
```

### rollback archive atomic stagingの別process隔離

`inspect-stage-transactions`がactive stage candidateを一件も返さなくても、`atomicStagingEntries`または`emptyAtomicStagingDirectories`がnonemptyならnew stage／maintenance mutationへ進まない。anchorを持つcomplete／partialは対応owner recoveryが先であり、この隔離actionはowner anchorなし、abandoned owner、またはempty write-key directoryだけを受理する。次のblockはverified inventoryからwrite-key directoryをexact 1件選び、whole directoryを隔離してresultを検証した後に必ずprocessを止める。初回は`$fsmcAtomicQuarantineReplay = $false`でfresh inspectを作る。actionを一度でも起動した後のresult-loss replayはtrueにして同じhistorical inspect／atomic path／result pathを使い、historical inspectをfresh current bytesで置換しない。replay branchでは旧inspectをstandalone current inventory verifierへ渡さず、同じhistorical bytes／selected pathをactionとaction-specific verifierへ渡してsource-present／quarantine-presentのclosed 2位置を検証する。historical inspect自体を失った場合は推測でresultを再生成せず、fresh inspectでquarantine inventoryを確認して当該actionを完了扱いにせず停止する。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcStageResultParent = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-existing-stage-recovery-result-parent>")
$fsmcAtomicInspectResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-same-historical-stage-inspect-result-path>")
$fsmcAtomicQuarantineResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-same-atomic-quarantine-result-path>")
$fsmcAtomicQuarantineReplay = $false # actionを一度でも起動した後はtrue
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcStageResultParent -PathType Container)) { throw "stage result parent must already exist" }
if (-not $fsmcAtomicQuarantineReplay) {
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcAtomicInspectResult) { throw "initial atomic inspect result path must be fresh" }
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action inspect-stage-transactions --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result-out $fsmcAtomicInspectResult | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "atomic staging inventory failed" }
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result $fsmcAtomicInspectResult | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "initial atomic staging inventory is not verified as current" }
} elseif (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcAtomicInspectResult -PathType Leaf)) {
  throw "historical atomic inspect result was lost; do not substitute a fresh inspect or infer completion"
}
$fsmcAtomicInventory = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcAtomicInspectResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcAtomicPropertyNames = @($fsmcAtomicInventory.PSObject.Properties.Name)
foreach ($fsmcRequiredProperty in @("atomicStagingEntries", "emptyAtomicStagingDirectories", "atomicStagingQuarantines")) {
  if ($fsmcAtomicPropertyNames -notcontains $fsmcRequiredProperty -or $null -eq $fsmcAtomicInventory.$fsmcRequiredProperty) {
    throw "stage inspect omitted $fsmcRequiredProperty"
  }
}
$fsmcKnownAtomicRelativePaths = @(
  @($fsmcAtomicInventory.atomicStagingEntries).stagingDirectoryRelativePath
  @($fsmcAtomicInventory.emptyAtomicStagingDirectories).stagingDirectoryRelativePath
) | Sort-Object -Unique
if ($fsmcKnownAtomicRelativePaths.Count -eq 0) { throw "verified inventory has no active atomic staging directory" }
$fsmcAtomicStagingRelativePath = "<exact-stagingDirectoryRelativePath-copied-from-verified-inventory>"
if ($fsmcKnownAtomicRelativePaths -notcontains $fsmcAtomicStagingRelativePath) {
  throw "selected atomic staging directory is not in the verified active inventory"
}
$fsmcAtomicStagingPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot $fsmcAtomicStagingRelativePath))
$fsmcArchiveRootPrefix = $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot.TrimEnd([IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar) + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
if (-not $fsmcAtomicStagingPath.StartsWith($fsmcArchiveRootPrefix, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
  throw "selected atomic staging directory escapes the archive root"
}
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action quarantine-atomic-staging --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --inspect-result $fsmcAtomicInspectResult --atomic-staging-path $fsmcAtomicStagingPath --result-out $fsmcAtomicQuarantineResult | Out-Host
$fsmcAtomicQuarantineExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --inspect-result $fsmcAtomicInspectResult --atomic-staging-path $fsmcAtomicStagingPath --result $fsmcAtomicQuarantineResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "atomic staging quarantine is not verified (action exit $fsmcAtomicQuarantineExitCode); use owner recovery if the adapter reports a live anchor" }
$fsmcAtomicQuarantined = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcAtomicQuarantineResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
if (
  $fsmcAtomicQuarantined.action -ne "quarantine-atomic-staging" -or
  $fsmcAtomicQuarantined.sourceAtomicStagingRelativePath -ne $fsmcAtomicStagingRelativePath -or
  -not $fsmcAtomicQuarantined.quarantineRelativePath -or
  -not $fsmcAtomicQuarantined.quarantinedEntriesDigest -or
  -not $fsmcAtomicQuarantined.resultDigest
) { throw "atomic staging quarantine result changed its closed contract" }
throw "atomic staging quarantined and verified; inspect from a fresh process before any recovery or mutation"
```

### stage transactionの別process recovery

release-quick parentを失った疑いがある場合は、新しいI11-B attemptを始める前に次のblockを別processで実行する。inspectはarchive rootの全stage transactionをread-only列挙する。初回構造回復は`active`、回復commit後～external result publish前のlossをsame result pathへ再生する場合は`completed`から、操作者がexact prepared pathを選ぶ。recoverはactiveだけで不足finalをmutationし、completedではarchive write 0のまま同じrecovery resultだけを再生成する。候補が複数なら各record IDについてblockを別processに分ける。command／verifier後もresultがmissing／invalidなら状態を推測せず、同じroot／prepared／recovery resultの3 pathを後日の新processへ再指定する。verified recovery後はそのprocessでreleaseやmanualを続けず、fresh processの`inspect-current`から旧attemptをdiscardする。source欠落かつfinal 3 path absentの場合だけ、下のstage-abandon blockを選ぶ。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcStageResultParent = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-existing-stage-recovery-result-parent>")
$fsmcStageInspectResult = Join-Path $fsmcStageResultParent ("inspect-stage-{0}.json" -f [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action inspect-stage-transactions --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result-out $fsmcStageInspectResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "stage transaction inventory failed" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result $fsmcStageInspectResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "stage transaction inventory is not verified" }
$fsmcStageInventory = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcStageInspectResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcStageInventoryPropertyNames = @($fsmcStageInventory.PSObject.Properties.Name)
foreach ($fsmcRequiredProperty in @("atomicStagingEntries", "emptyAtomicStagingDirectories", "atomicStagingQuarantines", "active", "completed", "abandoned")) {
  if ($fsmcStageInventoryPropertyNames -notcontains $fsmcRequiredProperty -or $null -eq $fsmcStageInventory.$fsmcRequiredProperty) {
    throw "stage transaction inventory omitted $fsmcRequiredProperty"
  }
}
$fsmcStageCandidates = @($fsmcStageInventory.active) + @($fsmcStageInventory.completed)
$fsmcActiveAtomicDirectoryCount = @(
  @($fsmcStageInventory.atomicStagingEntries).stagingDirectoryRelativePath
  @($fsmcStageInventory.emptyAtomicStagingDirectories).stagingDirectoryRelativePath
).Count
if ($fsmcStageCandidates.Count -eq 0 -and $fsmcActiveAtomicDirectoryCount -gt 0) {
  throw "no stage transaction anchor exists, but active atomic staging blocks progress; run the atomic staging quarantine block"
}
if ($fsmcStageCandidates.Count -eq 0) { throw "no active or completed stage transaction can satisfy recovery/replay" }
$fsmcPreparedStageTransaction = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<canonical-prepared-stage-path-copied-from-verified-active-or-completed-inventory>")
if (@($fsmcStageCandidates.preparedStageTransactionCanonicalPath) -notcontains $fsmcPreparedStageTransaction) {
  throw "selected stage transaction is not in the verified active/completed inventory"
}
$fsmcStageRecoveryResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-same-request-stage-recovery-result-path>")
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action recover-stage-transaction --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --stage-transaction $fsmcPreparedStageTransaction --result-out $fsmcStageRecoveryResult | Out-Host
$fsmcStageRecoveryExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --stage-inspect-result $fsmcStageInspectResult --stage-transaction $fsmcPreparedStageTransaction --result $fsmcStageRecoveryResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "stage recovery is not verified (action exit $fsmcStageRecoveryExitCode)" }
$fsmcStageRecovered = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcStageRecoveryResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
if (
  $fsmcStageRecovered.action -ne "recover-stage-transaction" -or
  $fsmcStageRecovered.recovered -ne $true -or
  $fsmcStageRecovered.releaseEvidenceCreated -ne $false -or
  -not $fsmcStageRecovered.archiveRecordCanonicalPath -or
  -not $fsmcStageRecovered.stageReceiptDigest -or
  -not $fsmcStageRecovered.resultDigest
) { throw "stage recovery result changed its closed contract" }
throw "stage structure recovered; stop this process and discard the failed-attempt record from a fresh maintenance process"
```

stage abandonmentもinitial／committed replayを分ける。初回だけ既存inspectをstandalone current verifierへ通し、action起動後は`$fsmcStageAbandonReplay = $true`として同じinspect path、prepared path、result pathを再指定する。replayでは旧inspectをcurrent inventoryとして検証せず、actionとaction-specific verifierがtombstoneの有無からhistorical bindingを判定する。replayには同じhistorical inspect fileのfull bytesが必須であり、失った場合はdigestだけからmissing resultを回収しない。fresh inspectで当該preparedが`abandoned`にexact 1件ありactiveでないことだけをcurrent確認して新attemptへ進み、旧result pathはmissingのままにする。fresh inspectをhistorical credentialへ差し替えたり、別preparedを推測したりしない。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcStageInspectResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-existing-verified-stage-inspect-result-path>")
$fsmcPreparedStageTransaction = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<canonical-active-prepared-stage-path-from-verified-inventory>")
$fsmcStageAbandonResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-same-stage-abandon-result-path>")
$fsmcStageAbandonReplay = $false # actionを一度でも起動した後はtrue
if (-not $fsmcStageAbandonReplay) {
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcStageInspectResult -PathType Leaf)) { throw "initial stage inspect result is missing" }
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result $fsmcStageInspectResult | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "initial stage transaction inventory is not verified as current" }
} elseif (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcStageInspectResult -PathType Leaf)) {
  throw "historical stage inspect result was lost; verify current abandoned state with a fresh inspect but do not regenerate the old result"
}
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcStageInspectResult -PathType Leaf) {
  $fsmcStageInventory = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcStageInspectResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
  $fsmcStageInventoryPropertyNames = @($fsmcStageInventory.PSObject.Properties.Name)
  foreach ($fsmcRequiredProperty in @("atomicStagingEntries", "emptyAtomicStagingDirectories", "atomicStagingQuarantines", "active", "completed", "abandoned")) {
    if ($fsmcStageInventoryPropertyNames -notcontains $fsmcRequiredProperty -or $null -eq $fsmcStageInventory.$fsmcRequiredProperty) {
      throw "stage transaction inventory omitted $fsmcRequiredProperty"
    }
  }
  if (@($fsmcStageInventory.active.preparedStageTransactionCanonicalPath) -notcontains $fsmcPreparedStageTransaction) {
    throw "selected stage transaction is not in the historical pre-abandon active inventory"
  }
}
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action abandon-stage-transaction --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --stage-inspect-result $fsmcStageInspectResult --stage-transaction $fsmcPreparedStageTransaction --reason-code source-roots-missing-before-pair-publish --result-out $fsmcStageAbandonResult | Out-Host
$fsmcStageAbandonExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --stage-inspect-result $fsmcStageInspectResult --stage-transaction $fsmcPreparedStageTransaction --result $fsmcStageAbandonResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "stage abandonment is not verified (action exit $fsmcStageAbandonExitCode)" }
throw "stage transaction abandoned without release evidence; start any release work as a fresh checkpoint attempt"
```

### stage abandonmentのhistorical inspect消失確認

stage abandonment commit後にexternal resultとhistorical inspectの両方を失った場合だけ、次のread-only blockを別processで実行する。これは旧resultを再構成せず、fresh current inventoryで選択preparedが`abandoned`にexact 1件、全active stage transactionが0件、未隔離atomic stagingが0件であることを確認する。確認後も同processでreleaseを始めず、fresh processの新Entry／新attemptへ進む。対象がactive／completedに残る、abandonmentが0件または複数、atomic stagingが残る場合は、それぞれrecovery／quarantineを先に行う。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcStageResultParent = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-existing-stage-recovery-result-parent>")
$fsmcAbandonedPreparedStageTransaction = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<same-canonical-prepared-stage-path-from-the-lost-historical-inspect>")
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcStageResultParent -PathType Container)) { throw "stage result parent must already exist" }
$fsmcFreshAbandonedStageInspect = Join-Path $fsmcStageResultParent ("inspect-abandoned-stage-{0}.json" -f [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcFreshAbandonedStageInspect) { throw "fresh abandoned-stage inspect result path must not exist" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action inspect-stage-transactions --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result-out $fsmcFreshAbandonedStageInspect | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "fresh abandoned-stage inventory failed" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result $fsmcFreshAbandonedStageInspect | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "fresh abandoned-stage inventory is not verified as current" }
$fsmcStageInventory = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcFreshAbandonedStageInspect -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcStageInventoryPropertyNames = @($fsmcStageInventory.PSObject.Properties.Name)
foreach ($fsmcRequiredProperty in @("atomicStagingEntries", "emptyAtomicStagingDirectories", "atomicStagingQuarantines", "active", "completed", "abandoned")) {
  if ($fsmcStageInventoryPropertyNames -notcontains $fsmcRequiredProperty -or $null -eq $fsmcStageInventory.$fsmcRequiredProperty) {
    throw "fresh abandoned-stage inventory omitted $fsmcRequiredProperty"
  }
}
$fsmcAbandonedMatches = @(
  $fsmcStageInventory.abandoned | Where-Object {
    [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($_.preparedStageTransactionCanonicalPath) -eq $fsmcAbandonedPreparedStageTransaction
  }
)
if ($fsmcAbandonedMatches.Count -ne 1) { throw "selected prepared stage transaction is not abandoned exactly once" }
$fsmcAbandonedStage = $fsmcAbandonedMatches[0]
if (
  [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($fsmcAbandonedStage.recordId) -or
  [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($fsmcAbandonedStage.preparedStageTransactionDigest) -or
  [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($fsmcAbandonedStage.abandonmentReceiptCanonicalPath) -or
  [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($fsmcAbandonedStage.abandonmentReceiptDigest)
) { throw "verified abandoned stage row omitted its durable binding" }
$fsmcTargetRecordId = [string]$fsmcAbandonedStage.recordId
if (@($fsmcStageInventory.active).Count -ne 0) { throw "an active stage transaction still requires recovery or abandonment" }
if (@($fsmcStageInventory.completed | Where-Object { $_.recordId -eq $fsmcTargetRecordId }).Count -ne 0) {
  throw "the abandoned record is also classified as completed"
}
$fsmcActiveAtomicStagingCount = @(
  @($fsmcStageInventory.atomicStagingEntries)
  @($fsmcStageInventory.emptyAtomicStagingDirectories)
).Count
if ($fsmcActiveAtomicStagingCount -ne 0) { throw "active atomic staging still requires owner recovery or quarantine" }
throw "stage abandonment is durably confirmed without reconstructing the lost result; stop and start a fresh checkpoint Entry in a new process"
```

### I11-B release候補

I11-Aは上記full quickと`--stage FSMC-I11-A` calibrationを使い、必要なら同checkpointでQMAXを再qualificationし、次のrelease commandを実行しない。I11-BのEntry verifierはI11-A receiptのQMAX 3 bindingとcurrent closureを比較し、3 surfaceが不変の場合だけgrantを発行する。差があればこのblockへ入らずI11-Aへ戻る。I11-Bだけがfinal candidateで次を実行する。 `scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-command.ps1`はtracked UTF-8 no-BOMのPowerShell 7 helperとして`Assert-FsmcExitCode`／`Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand`をexact exportし、tracked formal action launcherを各spawn直前にcanonical pathへ解決して、前段のinline normative definitionとbyte-equivalentなwrapper argv、result verifier、`$script:fsmcLastRecordedResult`投影だけを持つ。I11-Bの各別code blockは同process stateを仮定せずこのhelperを明示dot-sourceし、script blob OIDをcheckpoint command spec／change-surfaceへ拘束する。missing／別function／signature差ではEntry後commandを起動しない。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcCheckpointCommandHelper = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-command.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
. $fsmcCheckpointCommandHelper
if (
  -not (Get-Command Assert-FsmcExitCode -CommandType Function -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -or
  -not (Get-Command Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand -CommandType Function -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
) { throw "tracked checkpoint-command helper did not export its exact functions" }

$fsmcBaseSha = "<PRE-FSMC-BASE-001.comparisonBaseSha bound by parent receipt>"
$fsmcCheckpoint = "FSMC-I11-B"
$fsmcCandidateSha = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$fsmcParentReceipt = "<workspace-external-I11-A-receipt-path>"
$fsmcDeliveryReforecastReceipt = "<workspace-external-latest-I11-A-delivery-reforecast-receipt-path>"
$fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle = "<workspace-external-latest-pre-I11-B-delivery-authority-bundle-root>"
$fsmcDeliveryAuthorityManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcResultDir = "<workspace-external-new-command-result-directory>"
$fsmcReceiptOut = "<workspace-external-new-I11-B-checkpoint-receipt-path>"
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = "<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>"
$fsmcPwaProfileRoot = "<workspace-external-new-nonexistent-PWA-profile-root>"
$fsmcPwaReceiptOut = "<workspace-external-new-nonexistent-PWA-receipt-path>"
$fsmcNativeEvidenceOut = "<workspace-external-new-nonexistent-native-evidence-path>"
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-entry -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --parent-receipt $fsmcParentReceipt --delivery-authority-bundle $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityBundle --expected-delivery-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityManifest.manifestDigest --delivery-authority-latest-ref $fsmcDeliveryAuthorityManifest.latestLogicalRef --delivery-reforecast-receipt $fsmcDeliveryReforecastReceipt --result-dir $fsmcResultDir --receipt-out $fsmcReceiptOut
Assert-FsmcExitCode "checkpoint-entry" $LASTEXITCODE
Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand "release-quick" @("baseSha=$fsmcBaseSha", "archiveRoot=$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot", "pwaProfileRoot=$fsmcPwaProfileRoot", "pwaReceiptOut=$fsmcPwaReceiptOut", "nativeEvidenceOut=$fsmcNativeEvidenceOut")
$fsmcArchiveRecord = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.archiveRecordPath
$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.archiveRecordDigest
$fsmcStageReceipt = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.stageReceiptPath
$fsmcStageReceiptDigest = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.stageReceiptDigest
$fsmcPairDigest = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.pairDigest
$fsmcPwaReceiptDigest = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.pwaRollbackRehearsalReceiptDigest
$fsmcNativeEvidenceDigest = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.nativeBrowserInputEvidenceDigest
if (
  -not $fsmcArchiveRecord -or
  -not $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest -or
  -not $fsmcStageReceipt -or
  -not $fsmcStageReceiptDigest -or
  -not $fsmcPairDigest -or
  -not $fsmcPwaReceiptDigest -or
  -not $fsmcNativeEvidenceDigest -or
  $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.pwaRollbackRehearsalReceiptPath -ne [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcPwaReceiptOut) -or
  $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.nativeBrowserInputEvidencePath -ne [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcNativeEvidenceOut)
) {
  throw "release-quick result omitted archive, stage, PWA, native-input, or pair binding"
}
```

このouter commandはbuild pairの検証直後、production profile open 0件のままstage childをexact 1回実行し、それ以降はstaged bytesだけを使う。また`test:fsmc:fixed-a:release-compatibility`をchildとしてexact 1回所有し、adopted policyに対応する`B06/fixed-a-compatibility`とcanonical receipt生成を委譲する。generic childはjourney 16とは別にSW-blocked smokeと`QREL-PWA-WEB-01`をexact 1ずつ所有し、release B08はfresh native evidenceを生成する。操作者はstage child、fixed-A child、auxiliary spec、同Playwright tag、native helperを別途起動しない。release summaryはgeneric browser childとの重複0件、全release-required tupleとのexact bijection、auxiliary exact 2、各childのexit／duration、archive record path／digest／pair digest、compatibility／PWA／native path／digest／branchをdisk再hashしてから成功を返す。

release summaryが返したpair child外のrecord path／current record digestをcontinuity serverと以後のCAS actionへ渡す。profile rootは開始時emptyかつrelease run root／archive root外の検証済み一意directory、hostはexact `127.0.0.1`、port `0`は起動時に一つだけ割り当てて全artifact切替で維持する。CLI adapterはraw pathをarchive root内のcanonical relative pathへ解決し、manual／successor recordをstrict parse・rehashしてからtyped requestのID／digest／時刻fieldを作る。利用者提供digestだけをauthorityにせず、解決値と不一致ならmutation 0件で拒否する。各mutationの成功summaryが返す`afterRecordDigest`を次actionの`--expected-record-digest`へ必ず更新する。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcCheckpointCommandHelper = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/checkpoint-command.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
. $fsmcCheckpointCommandHelper
if (
  -not (Get-Command Assert-FsmcExitCode -CommandType Function -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -or
  -not (Get-Command Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand -CommandType Function -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
) { throw "tracked checkpoint-command helper did not export its exact functions" }

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcCheckpoint = "FSMC-I11-B"
$fsmcCandidateSha = "<same-lowercase-full-candidate-sha-as-verified-I11-B-entry>"
$fsmcParentReceipt = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-I11-A-receipt-path>")
$fsmcResultDir = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-existing-I11-B-result-directory>")
$fsmcReceiptOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-I11-B-checkpoint-receipt-path>")
$fsmcEntryGrantPath = Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "entry-grant.json"
$fsmcReleaseQuickResult = Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "release-quick.json"
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-result -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --command-id release-quick --command-instance-id release-quick --entry-grant $fsmcEntryGrantPath --result $fsmcReleaseQuickResult
Assert-FsmcExitCode "release-quick standalone result verifier" $LASTEXITCODE
$fsmcReleaseQuick = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcReleaseQuickResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcReleaseQuick.normalizedBindings.archiveRoot)
$fsmcArchiveRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcReleaseQuick.outputs.archiveRecordPath)
$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest = $fsmcReleaseQuick.outputs.archiveRecordDigest
$fsmcPersistentProfileRoot = "<workspace-external-new-nonexistent-persistent-profile-root-path>"
$fsmcManualRecord = "<workspace-external-new-nonexistent-manual-record-output-path>"
$fsmcPreExitClosureOut = "<workspace-external-new-nonexistent-pre-exit-closure-output-path>"
Invoke-FsmcRecordedCommand "release-manual" @("archiveRoot=$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot", "archiveRecord=$fsmcArchiveRecord", "expectedRecordDigest=$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest", "profileRoot=$fsmcPersistentProfileRoot", "manualRecordOut=$fsmcManualRecord", "releaseQuickResult=$fsmcReleaseQuickResult", "preExitClosureOut=$fsmcPreExitClosureOut")
$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.afterArchiveRecordDigest
$fsmcManualOperation = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.manualOperationPath
$fsmcManualRecordDigest = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.manualRecordDigest
$fsmcPreExitClosureDigest = $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.preExitClosureReceiptDigest
if (
  -not $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest -or
  -not $fsmcManualOperation -or
  -not $fsmcManualRecordDigest -or
  -not $fsmcPreExitClosureDigest -or
  $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.preExitClosureReceiptPath -ne [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcPreExitClosureOut) -or
  $fsmcLastRecordedResult.outputs.persistentProfileRootCanonicalPath -ne [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcPersistentProfileRoot)
) {
  throw "release-manual result omitted or changed its archive, operation, manual, pre-Exit closure, or profile binding"
}
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run record:fsmc:checkpoint-exit -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --parent-receipt $fsmcParentReceipt --result-dir $fsmcResultDir --manual-record $fsmcManualRecord --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --receipt-out $fsmcReceiptOut
Assert-FsmcExitCode "checkpoint-exit" $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-exit -- --receipt $fsmcReceiptOut
Assert-FsmcExitCode "checkpoint-exit verifier" $LASTEXITCODE
```

上のI11-B processが`release-quick` result publish後からverified Exit seal前までに失われた場合だけ、後日の新PowerShell processで次のblockを使う。入口は既存result directoryのexact 1 pathだけで、current `HEAD`、前process変数、手入力digestを使わない。`verify:fsmc:release:manual-resume`はentry grant、release-quick result／summary／artifact、決定的`release-manual-operation/operation.json`、clock chain、manual record、pre-Exit closure、current archive／prepared／receipt、存在するmanual summary／resultをread-only strict検証し、同じattempt／grant／command instance／7 normalized bindings／full resolved invocationを再構成する。manual record seal前のloss、operation不在、immutable failure result、別environment／binding、abandoned preparedではexit non-zeroとし、このattemptをExitへ進めずfresh Entry／result directory／empty profile／manual outputでやり直す。exit 0後だけ同じcheckpoint wrapperをexact 1回呼び、functional manualは再実行せずprepared／summary／resultの不足分を完成または既存successをread-only replayしてExitをsealする。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcCheckpoint = "FSMC-I11-B"
$fsmcResultDir = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-existing-I11-B-result-directory>")
$fsmcEntryGrantPath = Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "entry-grant.json"
$fsmcReleaseQuickResultPath = Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "release-quick.json"
$fsmcReleaseManualResultPath = Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "release-manual.json"
$fsmcManualOperationPath = Join-Path (Join-Path $fsmcResultDir "release-manual-operation") "operation.json"

& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:release:manual-resume -- --result-dir $fsmcResultDir | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "I11-B manual operation is not eligible for same-attempt read-only resume" }

$fsmcEntryGrant = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcEntryGrantPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcReleaseQuick = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcReleaseQuickResultPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcManualOperationEvidence = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcManualOperationPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
if (
  $fsmcEntryGrant.checkpointId -ne $fsmcCheckpoint -or
  $fsmcEntryGrant.resultDirCanonicalPath -ne $fsmcResultDir -or
  $fsmcReleaseQuick.commandId -ne "release-quick" -or
  $fsmcReleaseQuick.commandInstanceId -ne "release-quick" -or
  $fsmcReleaseQuick.status -ne "passed" -or
  $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.commandId -ne "release-manual" -or
  $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.commandInstanceId -ne "release-manual" -or
  $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.attemptId -ne $fsmcEntryGrant.attemptId -or
  $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.entryGrantDigest -ne $fsmcEntryGrant.entryGrantDigest
) { throw "persisted I11-B grant, quick result, or manual operation binding is inconsistent" }

$fsmcCandidateSha = [string] $fsmcEntryGrant.candidateSha
$fsmcParentReceipt = [string] $fsmcEntryGrant.parentReceiptCanonicalPath
$fsmcReceiptOut = [string] $fsmcEntryGrant.receiptOutCanonicalPath
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-result -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --command-id release-quick --command-instance-id release-quick --entry-grant $fsmcEntryGrantPath --result $fsmcReleaseQuickResultPath | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "persisted release-quick result failed read-only verification" }

$fsmcBaseSha = [string] $fsmcReleaseQuick.normalizedBindings.baseSha
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string] $fsmcReleaseQuick.normalizedBindings.archiveRoot)
$fsmcArchiveRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string] $fsmcReleaseQuick.outputs.archiveRecordPath)
$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest = [string] $fsmcReleaseQuick.outputs.archiveRecordDigest
$fsmcPersistentProfileRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string] $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.normalizedBindings.profileRoot)
$fsmcManualRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string] $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.normalizedBindings.manualRecordOut)
$fsmcBoundReleaseQuickResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string] $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.normalizedBindings.releaseQuickResult)
$fsmcPreExitClosureOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string] $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.normalizedBindings.preExitClosureOut)
if (
  $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.normalizedBindings.archiveRoot -ne $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot -or
  $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.normalizedBindings.archiveRecord -ne $fsmcArchiveRecord -or
  $fsmcManualOperationEvidence.normalizedBindings.expectedRecordDigest -ne $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest -or
  $fsmcBoundReleaseQuickResult -ne [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($fsmcReleaseQuickResultPath)
) { throw "manual operation does not bind the verified staged release-quick result" }

$fsmcResumeWrapperArgs = @(
  "run", "run:fsmc:checkpoint-command", "--",
  "--checkpoint", $fsmcCheckpoint,
  "--candidate-sha", $fsmcCandidateSha,
  "--result-dir", $fsmcResultDir,
  "--command-id", "release-manual",
  "--command-instance-id", "release-manual",
  "--binding", "archiveRoot=$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot",
  "--binding", "archiveRecord=$fsmcArchiveRecord",
  "--binding", "expectedRecordDigest=$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest",
  "--binding", "profileRoot=$fsmcPersistentProfileRoot",
  "--binding", "manualRecordOut=$fsmcManualRecord",
  "--binding", "releaseQuickResult=$fsmcBoundReleaseQuickResult",
  "--binding", "preExitClosureOut=$fsmcPreExitClosureOut"
)
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand @fsmcResumeWrapperArgs | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "release-manual same-attempt resume did not complete" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-result -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --command-id release-manual --command-instance-id release-manual --entry-grant $fsmcEntryGrantPath --result $fsmcReleaseManualResultPath | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "recovered release-manual result failed read-only verification" }

$fsmcReleaseManual = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcReleaseManualResultPath -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
if (
  $fsmcReleaseManual.status -ne "passed" -or
  $fsmcReleaseManual.outputs.manualOperationPath -ne $fsmcManualOperationPath -or
  $fsmcReleaseManual.outputs.manualRecordPath -ne $fsmcManualRecord -or
  $fsmcReleaseManual.outputs.archiveRecordPath -ne $fsmcArchiveRecord -or
  $fsmcReleaseManual.outputs.beforeArchiveRecordDigest -ne $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest -or
  $fsmcReleaseManual.outputs.preExitClosureReceiptPath -ne $fsmcPreExitClosureOut -or
  -not $fsmcReleaseManual.outputs.preExitClosureReceiptDigest -or
  $fsmcReleaseManual.outputs.persistentProfileRootCanonicalPath -ne $fsmcPersistentProfileRoot
) { throw "recovered release-manual result changed its durable binding" }

& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run record:fsmc:checkpoint-exit -- --checkpoint $fsmcCheckpoint --candidate-sha $fsmcCandidateSha --parent-receipt $fsmcParentReceipt --result-dir $fsmcResultDir --manual-record $fsmcManualRecord --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --receipt-out $fsmcReceiptOut | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "I11-B Exit seal or exact replay failed" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-exit -- --receipt $fsmcReceiptOut | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "I11-B recovered Exit receipt failed self-contained verification" }
```

### commit不能preparedのowner control

fresh precondition不一致、manual deadline、またはcommit前の明示cancelでpreparedを安全に完遂できないと専用owner verifierが確定した場合だけ、通常data-plane blockを再実行せず次の3 blockからownerに一致するexact 1件を選ぶ。各blockのresult pathは同じcontrol requestの再開では同じpath、新しいcontrol requestでは開始時不存在pathとする。command後は必ずread-only verifierを実行し、verified resultを得ても元manual attempt／publication attemptはfailedのまま終了する。同processでExit、publish、新archive actionへ進まない。

release-manual owner:

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcArchiveRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<absolute-canonical-archive-record-path>")
$fsmcManualOperationPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<persisted-release-manual-operation-path>")
$fsmcAbandonReason = "<owner-deadline-expired|fresh-precondition-invalidated|operator-cancelled-before-commit>"
$fsmcAbandonResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-same-owner-control-result-path>")
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action abandon-prepared-transaction --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --manual-operation $fsmcManualOperationPath --reason-code $fsmcAbandonReason --result-out $fsmcAbandonResult | Out-Host
$fsmcAbandonExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --manual-operation $fsmcManualOperationPath --result $fsmcAbandonResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "release-manual prepared abandonment is not verified (action exit $fsmcAbandonExitCode)" }
throw "release-manual attempt is abandoned and cannot seal Exit"
```

publish-release owner:

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcArchiveRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<absolute-canonical-archive-record-path>")
$fsmcReceiptOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<same-original-I11-B-exit-receipt-path>")
$fsmcReleaseSourceBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<same-original-release-source-bundle-root>")
$fsmcReleaseAdmission = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<same-original-release-admission-path>")
$fsmcPublicationResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<same-original-publication-data-plane-result-path>")
$fsmcAbandonReason = "<fresh-precondition-invalidated|operator-cancelled-before-commit>"
$fsmcAbandonResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-same-owner-control-result-path>")
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action abandon-prepared-transaction --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --exit-receipt $fsmcReceiptOut --source-bundle $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle --release-admission $fsmcReleaseAdmission --publication-result-out $fsmcPublicationResult --reason-code $fsmcAbandonReason --result-out $fsmcAbandonResult | Out-Host
$fsmcAbandonExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --exit-receipt $fsmcReceiptOut --source-bundle $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle --release-admission $fsmcReleaseAdmission --publication-result-out $fsmcPublicationResult --result $fsmcAbandonResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "publish-release prepared abandonment is not verified (action exit $fsmcAbandonExitCode)" }
throw "publication attempt is abandoned; keep both controls OFF"
```

archive-maintenance owner。fresh-precondition-invalidatedではcommon bootstrapのauto-resumeを呼ばず、同じhistorical inspect／control result pathを全再開processで維持する。`$fsmcReplayCommittedAbandonment = $false`はtombstone作成を一度も試していない初回だけに選ぶ。以前のprocessがtombstoneをcommitした可能性を否定できない時は必ずtrueとし、historical pathがmissingでもそこへfresh current inspectを作らない。action／verifierがmatching tombstone snapshotからhistorical credentialを自動復元し、matching tombstoneがなければwrite 0で停止する。そのfailureがtombstone前lossかを推測せず、直後のreplacement blockでfresh current evidenceを得る:

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcArchiveRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<absolute-canonical-archive-record-path>")
$fsmcInspectResultOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-same-historical-inspect-current-result-path>")
$fsmcAbandonResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-same-owner-control-result-path>")
$fsmcAbandonReason = "<fresh-precondition-invalidated|operator-cancelled-before-commit>"
$fsmcReplayCommittedAbandonment = $false # prior action/tombstone commitが不確定ならtrue
if (-not $fsmcReplayCommittedAbandonment) {
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcInspectResultOut) { throw "initial historical inspect result path must be fresh" }
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action inspect-current --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --result-out $fsmcInspectResultOut | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "maintenance owner inspect-current failed" }
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --result $fsmcInspectResultOut | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "maintenance owner inspection is not verified" }
  $fsmcOwnerInspection = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcInspectResultOut -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
  if (
    $fsmcOwnerInspection.action -ne "inspect-current" -or
    $fsmcOwnerInspection.archiveRootCanonicalPath -ne $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot -or
    $fsmcOwnerInspection.archiveRecordCanonicalPath -ne $fsmcArchiveRecord -or
    $fsmcOwnerInspection.recoveryHead.recoveryOwner -ne "archive-maintenance" -or
    $fsmcOwnerInspection.recoveryHead.completionState -ne "prepared-before"
  ) { throw "initial inspection does not select an abandonable maintenance prepared head" }
}
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action abandon-prepared-transaction --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --inspect-result $fsmcInspectResultOut --reason-code $fsmcAbandonReason --result-out $fsmcAbandonResult | Out-Host
$fsmcAbandonExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --inspect-result $fsmcInspectResultOut --result $fsmcAbandonResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "archive-maintenance prepared abandonment is not verified (action exit $fsmcAbandonExitCode)" }
throw "maintenance prepared transaction abandoned; start any new action from a fresh inspect process"
```

replay modeがhistorical inspect missingかつmatching tombstoneなしで停止した場合だけ、次を別processで実行する。これは旧pathを再生成せず、fresh inspectが現在もarchive-maintenance ownerのprepared-before headを選び、そのpreparedにtombstoneがないことを証明してからnew owner-control requestを作る。`$fsmcExpectedPreparedTransactionDigest`はfresh verified inventoryから操作者が明示選択したhead digestでありaction CLIへは渡さない。旧requestがcommit済み、headが進んだ、または別preparedしかない場合はこのblockを使わない。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcArchiveRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<absolute-canonical-archive-record-path>")
$fsmcReplacementInspect = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-fresh-replacement-inspect-result-path>")
$fsmcReplacementAbandonResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-fresh-replacement-owner-control-result-path>")
$fsmcExpectedPreparedTransactionDigest = "<64-lowercase-hex-digest-selected-from-this-fresh-verified-head>"
$fsmcAbandonReason = "<fresh-precondition-invalidated|operator-cancelled-before-commit>"
if (
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcReplacementInspect) -or
  (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcReplacementAbandonResult)
) { throw "replacement inspect and result paths must both be fresh" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action inspect-current --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --result-out $fsmcReplacementInspect | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "replacement maintenance inspection failed" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --result $fsmcReplacementInspect | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "replacement maintenance inspection is not verified" }
$fsmcReplacementEvidence = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcReplacementInspect -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcReplacementHead = $fsmcReplacementEvidence.recoveryHead
if (
  $fsmcExpectedPreparedTransactionDigest -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or
  $null -eq $fsmcReplacementHead -or
  $fsmcReplacementHead.recoveryOwner -ne "archive-maintenance" -or
  $fsmcReplacementHead.completionState -ne "prepared-before" -or
  $fsmcReplacementHead.preparedTransactionDigest -ne $fsmcExpectedPreparedTransactionDigest
) { throw "fresh inspection does not select the explicitly confirmed maintenance prepared-before head" }
$fsmcMatchingAbandonments = @(
  $fsmcReplacementEvidence.abandonedPreparedTransactions |
    Where-Object { $_.preparedTransactionDigest -eq $fsmcExpectedPreparedTransactionDigest }
)
if ($fsmcMatchingAbandonments.Count -ne 0) { throw "matching abandonment already exists; use historical tombstone replay, not a replacement request" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run archive:fsmc:release-pair -- --action abandon-prepared-transaction --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --inspect-result $fsmcReplacementInspect --reason-code $fsmcAbandonReason --result-out $fsmcReplacementAbandonResult | Out-Host
$fsmcReplacementAbandonExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --inspect-result $fsmcReplacementInspect --result $fsmcReplacementAbandonResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "replacement maintenance abandonment is not verified (action exit $fsmcReplacementAbandonExitCode)" }
throw "replacement owner-control request abandoned the verified prepared head; start any new action from a fresh inspect process"
```

公開判断時だけ次のblockを実行する。これは上のprocessの変数へ依存せず、archive root、record、検証済みExit receipt、latest pre-I11-B authority receipt＋bundle、owner-approved input、post-I11-B scheduled receipt＋fresh next bundle、latest scheduled／recovery receipt＋bundle、verified source bundle root、verified admission、workspace外publication resultのexact 13 path bindingを再指定すれば（recoveryなしではscheduledとlatestのreceipt／bundleをそれぞれ同じpathにする）後日の別processから再開できる。post-I11-B scheduled receipt＋bundleは両方absent時だけno-clobber生成し、一方だけpresentなら停止する。source bundle／admissionも両方absentの初回だけExit＋latest delivery authority manifestのexact 2-root bundleから順に生成し、一方だけpresent、既存bytes不正、別Exit bindingなら停止する。publisher自身へ渡すdata-plane引数は従来どおりexact 6 pathとする。1 processではpublishをexact 1回だけ起動し、既存resultがあれば上書きせず直ちに検証する。resultがmissing／未検証なら既知failureとcommit-lossを推測で区別せず両control OFFのまま停止し、操作者が後日の新processで同じ13-binding blockを明示再実行する。その専用commandだけがprepared-beforeのfresh continuity再検査またはcommitted result再生成を行う。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcArchiveRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<absolute-canonical-archive-record-path>")
$fsmcReceiptOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-I11-B-exit-receipt-path>")
$fsmcPostI11PreviousDeliveryAuthority = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<latest-pre-I11-B-scheduled-or-recovery-authority-receipt-path>")
$fsmcPostI11PreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<latest-pre-I11-B-delivery-authority-bundle-root>")
$fsmcPostI11DeliveryApprovalInput = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<existing-workspace-external-post-I11-B-owner-approved-input-path>")
$fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryReforecast = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-or-existing-same-request-post-I11-B-scheduled-reforecast-path>")
$fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-or-existing-same-request-post-I11-B-scheduled-authority-bundle-root>")
$fsmcPostI11DeliveryReforecast = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<same-scheduled-path-or-existing-latest-post-I11-B-recovery-head-path>")
$fsmcPostI11DeliveryAuthorityBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<same-scheduled-bundle-or-existing-latest-post-I11-B-recovery-bundle-root>")
$fsmcReleaseSourceBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-existing-same-request-release-source-bundle-root>")
$fsmcReleaseAdmission = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-existing-same-request-release-admission-path>")
$fsmcPublicationResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-new-or-same-request-resume-publication-result-path>")
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:checkpoint-exit -- --receipt $fsmcReceiptOut | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "I11-B Exit receipt failed its self-contained pre-publication verification" }
$fsmcPostI11PreviousManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcPostI11PreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcScheduledReceiptExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryReforecast -PathType Leaf
$fsmcScheduledBundleExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundle -PathType Container
if ($fsmcScheduledReceiptExists -xor $fsmcScheduledBundleExists) {
  throw "post-I11-B scheduled receipt and authority bundle must be both absent or both present"
}
if (-not $fsmcScheduledReceiptExists) {
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run reforecast:fsmc:delivery -- `
    --trigger-kind scheduled `
    --trigger-id I11-B `
    --trigger-evidence $fsmcReceiptOut `
    --previous-authority-bundle $fsmcPostI11PreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle `
    --expected-previous-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcPostI11PreviousManifest.manifestDigest `
    --previous-authority-latest-ref $fsmcPostI11PreviousManifest.latestLogicalRef `
    --previous-authority $fsmcPostI11PreviousDeliveryAuthority `
    --approval-input $fsmcPostI11DeliveryApprovalInput `
    --receipt-out $fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryReforecast `
    --next-authority-bundle-out $fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundle | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "post-I11-B delivery reforecast failed" }
}
$fsmcPostI11ScheduledManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundle "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:delivery-reforecast -- --authority-bundle $fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundle --expected-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcPostI11ScheduledManifest.manifestDigest --authority-latest-ref $fsmcPostI11ScheduledManifest.latestLogicalRef --expected-latest-authority $fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryReforecast | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "post-I11-B scheduled delivery reforecast is not verified" }
if (
  -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPostI11DeliveryReforecast -PathType Leaf) -or
  -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcPostI11DeliveryAuthorityBundle -PathType Container)
) {
  throw "latest post-I11-B receipt or authority bundle is missing; after scheduled no-go, produce an owner-approved recovery bundle before admission"
}
$fsmcPostI11LatestManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcPostI11DeliveryAuthorityBundle "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:delivery-reforecast -- --authority-bundle $fsmcPostI11DeliveryAuthorityBundle --expected-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcPostI11LatestManifest.manifestDigest --authority-latest-ref $fsmcPostI11LatestManifest.latestLogicalRef --expected-latest-authority $fsmcPostI11DeliveryReforecast --required-ancestor-ref $fsmcPostI11ScheduledManifest.latestLogicalRef --required-ancestor-authority $fsmcPostI11ScheduledDeliveryReforecast | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "latest post-I11-B scheduled/recovery chain is not verified" }
$fsmcPostI11Delivery = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcPostI11DeliveryReforecast -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcPostI11TriggerValid = (
  ($fsmcPostI11Delivery.trigger.kind -eq "scheduled" -and $fsmcPostI11Delivery.trigger.triggerId -eq "I11-B") -or
  $fsmcPostI11Delivery.trigger.kind -eq "recovery"
)
if (
  -not $fsmcPostI11TriggerValid -or
  $fsmcPostI11Delivery.featureAdmission -ne "go" -or
  $fsmcPostI11Delivery.milestones[7].status -ne "completed" -or
  $fsmcPostI11Delivery.milestones[8].status -ne "pending"
) { throw "post-I11-B delivery receipt did not close M7 and preserve M8 pending" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle) -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcReleaseAdmission)) {
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run export:fsmc:receipt-bundle -- --root-receipt $fsmcReceiptOut --root-kind checkpoint-exit --additional-root-bundle $fsmcPostI11DeliveryAuthorityBundle --additional-root-kind delivery-authority --bundle-out $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "release source bundle export failed" }
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run export:fsmc:release-admission -- --exit-receipt $fsmcReceiptOut --delivery-authority-bundle $fsmcPostI11DeliveryAuthorityBundle --expected-delivery-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcPostI11LatestManifest.manifestDigest --delivery-authority-latest-ref $fsmcPostI11LatestManifest.latestLogicalRef --delivery-reforecast-receipt $fsmcPostI11DeliveryReforecast --source-bundle $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle --admission-out $fsmcReleaseAdmission | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "release admission export failed" }
} elseif (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcReleaseAdmission)) {
  throw "release bundle and admission must be both absent for initial export or both present for exact replay"
}
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:receipt-bundle -- --bundle $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "release source bundle verification failed" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:release-admission -- --exit-receipt $fsmcReceiptOut --delivery-authority-bundle $fsmcPostI11DeliveryAuthorityBundle --expected-delivery-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcPostI11LatestManifest.manifestDigest --delivery-authority-latest-ref $fsmcPostI11LatestManifest.latestLogicalRef --delivery-reforecast-receipt $fsmcPostI11DeliveryReforecast --source-bundle $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle --admission $fsmcReleaseAdmission | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "release admission verification failed" }
$fsmcPublishArgs = @(
  "run", "publish:fsmc:release", "--",
  "--archive-root", $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot,
  "--archive-record", $fsmcArchiveRecord,
  "--exit-receipt", $fsmcReceiptOut,
  "--source-bundle", $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle,
  "--release-admission", $fsmcReleaseAdmission,
  "--result-out", $fsmcPublicationResult
)
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand @fsmcPublishArgs | Out-Host
$fsmcPublishExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:release:publication -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result $fsmcPublicationResult --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --exit-receipt $fsmcReceiptOut --source-bundle $fsmcReleaseSourceBundle --release-admission $fsmcReleaseAdmission | Out-Host
$fsmcPublicationVerifyExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($fsmcPublicationVerifyExitCode -ne 0) {
  throw "publication is not verified (publish exit $fsmcPublishExitCode); keep both controls OFF and rerun these same six paths in a new process"
}
$fsmcPublished = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcPublicationResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$fsmcDigestPattern = '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
if (
  $fsmcPublished.action -ne "publish-release" -or
  -not [IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified([string] $fsmcPublished.publicationReceiptCanonicalPath) -or
  $fsmcPublished.publicationReceiptDigest -notmatch $fsmcDigestPattern -or
  $fsmcPublished.releaseAdmissionDigest -notmatch $fsmcDigestPattern -or
  $fsmcPublished.sourceBundleDigest -notmatch $fsmcDigestPattern -or
  $fsmcPublished.beforeArchiveRecordDigest -notmatch $fsmcDigestPattern -or
  $fsmcPublished.afterArchiveRecordDigest -notmatch $fsmcDigestPattern -or
  $fsmcPublished.pairDigest -notmatch $fsmcDigestPattern -or
  $fsmcPublished.resultDigest -notmatch $fsmcDigestPattern
) { throw "publish-release returned an invalid verified external result" }
$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest = $fsmcPublished.afterArchiveRecordDigest
$fsmcPairDigest = $fsmcPublished.pairDigest
```

公開後の後継確認／incident hold／cleanup、または未公開discardは相互に適格な時点で別々に実行する。各actionはbefore record digestをCASとして再検査し、successor／pair digest、reason、時刻、削除件数をtyped mutation receiptへ固定する。後日の各PowerShell processは、前processの変数、workspace外Exit、手入力digestを継承せず、最初に次のcommon blockを再実行する。`inspect-current`がarchive内record、state-discriminated `maintenanceAnchor`、`recoveryHead`を検証してcurrent digest／pair digestをbootstrapする。result pathがabsentの時だけhelperは全く同じargvをexact 1回再投入し、presentなmalformed resultは上書きせずverifierで停止する。前processの結果が検証済みなら`$fsmcRecoverIndeterminateHead = $false`、commit／result publishの成否が不明なら新actionより先にtrueとする。pending／terminal deletion incompleteなmaintenance headは常に完遂し、trueのcommitted headは失われたresultを再生成する。manual／publish ownerはgeneric resumeせず専用commandへroutingする。maintenance recovery resultを得たprocessもそのverified pathを表示して終了し、新action／assessmentはfresh processへ分ける。action processがnon-zeroでもverifierがcurrent record／prepared transaction／receiptを一致させた場合だけ回復成功とし、verified machine resultのafter digestだけを同process内の次CASへ渡す。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcDurableArchiveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<validated-explicit-local-archive-root>")
$fsmcArchiveRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<absolute-canonical-archive-record-path>")
$fsmcArchiveActionResultParent = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<workspace-external-existing-dedicated-archive-action-result-parent>")
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcArchiveActionResultParent -PathType Container)) {
  throw "archive action result parent must already exist"
}

function Invoke-FsmcExactResultCommand {
  param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string[]] $Arguments,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string] $ResultOut
  )

  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand @Arguments | Out-Host
  $fsmcFirstExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
  $fsmcReplayExitCode = $null
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $ResultOut)) {
    & $fsmcFormalActionCommand @Arguments | Out-Host
    $fsmcReplayExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
  }
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    FirstExitCode = $fsmcFirstExitCode
    ReplayExitCode = $fsmcReplayExitCode
  }
}

function Get-FsmcArchiveCurrentBinding {
  $fsmcInspectResultOut = Join-Path $fsmcArchiveActionResultParent ("inspect-current-{0}.json" -f [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcInspectResultOut) { throw "inspect result path must be fresh" }
  $fsmcInspectArgs = @(
    "run", "archive:fsmc:release-pair", "--",
    "--action", "inspect-current",
    "--archive-root", $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot,
    "--archive-record", $fsmcArchiveRecord,
    "--result-out", $fsmcInspectResultOut
  )
  $fsmcInspectExecution = Invoke-FsmcExactResultCommand $fsmcInspectArgs $fsmcInspectResultOut
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result $fsmcInspectResultOut --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "current archive binding is not verified (inspect exit $($fsmcInspectExecution.FirstExitCode); exact replay exit $($fsmcInspectExecution.ReplayExitCode))"
  }
  $fsmcInspectResult = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcInspectResultOut -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
  $fsmcInspectPropertyNames = @($fsmcInspectResult.PSObject.Properties.Name)
  if (
    $fsmcInspectResult.action -ne "inspect-current" -or
    $fsmcInspectResult.archiveRootCanonicalPath -ne $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot -or
    $fsmcInspectResult.archiveRecordCanonicalPath -ne $fsmcArchiveRecord -or
    -not $fsmcInspectResult.currentRecordDigest -or
    -not $fsmcInspectResult.pairDigest -or
    -not $fsmcInspectResult.state -or
    $null -eq $fsmcInspectResult.maintenanceAnchor -or
    $fsmcInspectPropertyNames -notcontains "atomicStagingEntries" -or
    $null -eq $fsmcInspectResult.atomicStagingEntries -or
    $fsmcInspectPropertyNames -notcontains "emptyAtomicStagingDirectories" -or
    $null -eq $fsmcInspectResult.emptyAtomicStagingDirectories -or
    $fsmcInspectPropertyNames -notcontains "atomicStagingQuarantines" -or
    $null -eq $fsmcInspectResult.atomicStagingQuarantines -or
    -not $fsmcInspectResult.resultDigest
  ) { throw "inspect-current returned an invalid canonical binding" }
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    Path = $fsmcInspectResultOut
    Evidence = $fsmcInspectResult
  }
}

function Resume-FsmcArchiveHead {
  param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [pscustomobject] $Inspection
  )

  $fsmcHead = $Inspection.Evidence.recoveryHead
  if ($null -eq $fsmcHead) { throw "archive has no replayable recovery head" }
  if ($fsmcHead.recoveryOwner -eq "release-manual") {
    throw "recovery head belongs to release-manual; rerun the dedicated release-manual command with its persisted operation and result bindings"
  }
  if ($fsmcHead.recoveryOwner -eq "publish-release") {
    throw "recovery head belongs to publish-release; rerun the dedicated six-path publication block with both controls OFF"
  }
  if ($fsmcHead.recoveryOwner -ne "archive-maintenance") {
    throw "archive recovery head has an unknown owner"
  }

  $fsmcResumeResultOut = Join-Path $fsmcArchiveActionResultParent ("resume-head-{0}.json" -f [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcResumeResultOut) { throw "resume result path must be fresh" }
  $fsmcResumeArgs = @(
    "run", "archive:fsmc:release-pair", "--",
    "--action", "resume-head-transaction",
    "--archive-root", $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot,
    "--archive-record", $fsmcArchiveRecord,
    "--inspect-result", $Inspection.Path,
    "--result-out", $fsmcResumeResultOut
  )
  $fsmcResumeExecution = Invoke-FsmcExactResultCommand $fsmcResumeArgs $fsmcResumeResultOut
  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord --inspect-result $Inspection.Path --result $fsmcResumeResultOut | Out-Host
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "archive head recovery is not verified (resume exit $($fsmcResumeExecution.FirstExitCode); exact replay exit $($fsmcResumeExecution.ReplayExitCode))"
  }
  $fsmcResumeResult = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcResumeResultOut -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
  if (
    $fsmcResumeResult.action -ne $fsmcHead.action -or
    $fsmcResumeResult.requestKeyDigest -ne $fsmcHead.requestKeyDigest -or
    $fsmcResumeResult.beforeRecordDigest -ne $fsmcHead.expectedBeforeRecordDigest -or
    -not $fsmcResumeResult.afterRecordDigest -or
    -not $fsmcResumeResult.mutationReceiptDigest -or
    $fsmcResumeResult.recovered -ne $true -or
    -not $fsmcResumeResult.resultDigest
  ) { throw "archive head recovery returned an invalid verified result" }
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    Path = $fsmcResumeResultOut
    Evidence = $fsmcResumeResult
  }
}

function Get-FsmcArchiveReadyBinding {
  param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [bool] $RecoverIndeterminateHead
  )

  $fsmcInspection = Get-FsmcArchiveCurrentBinding
  $fsmcHead = $fsmcInspection.Evidence.recoveryHead
  $fsmcRecovered = $null
  if ($null -eq $fsmcHead) {
    if ($RecoverIndeterminateHead) { throw "no recovery head exists for the indeterminate-operation request" }
  } else {
    $fsmcMustComplete = $fsmcHead.completionState -in @("prepared-before", "terminal-deletion-incomplete")
    if ($fsmcMustComplete -or $RecoverIndeterminateHead) {
      $fsmcRecovered = Resume-FsmcArchiveHead $fsmcInspection
      $fsmcInspection = Get-FsmcArchiveCurrentBinding
    }
  }
  $fsmcCurrentRecordId = $fsmcInspection.Evidence.recordId
  $fsmcBlockingAtomicDirectories = @(
    @($fsmcInspection.Evidence.atomicStagingEntries | Where-Object { $_.recordId -eq $fsmcCurrentRecordId }).stagingDirectoryRelativePath
    @($fsmcInspection.Evidence.emptyAtomicStagingDirectories | Where-Object { $_.recordId -eq $fsmcCurrentRecordId }).stagingDirectoryRelativePath
  ) | Sort-Object -Unique
  if ($fsmcBlockingAtomicDirectories.Count -gt 0) {
    throw "active atomic staging blocks a new mutation for this record; run the exact quarantine block or the reported owner recovery first: $($fsmcBlockingAtomicDirectories -join ', ')"
  }
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    Path = $fsmcInspection.Path
    Evidence = $fsmcInspection.Evidence
    RecoveredResultPath = if ($null -eq $fsmcRecovered) { $null } else { $fsmcRecovered.Path }
    RecoveredResult = if ($null -eq $fsmcRecovered) { $null } else { $fsmcRecovered.Evidence }
  }
}

function Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction {
  param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [ValidateSet("bind-provider-distribution", "prepare-provider-reactivation", "bind-provider-reactivation", "abort-provider-reactivation", "mark-successor-verified", "set-incident-hold", "clear-incident-hold", "assess-cleanup", "cleanup-published", "discard-unpublished")]
    [string] $Action,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string] $ExpectedRecordDigest,
    [string[]] $ExtraArguments = @()
  )

  $fsmcActionResultOut = Join-Path $fsmcArchiveActionResultParent ("{0}-{1}.json" -f $Action, [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcActionResultOut) { throw "archive action result path must be fresh" }
  $fsmcActionArgs = @(
    "run", "archive:fsmc:release-pair", "--",
    "--action", $Action,
    "--archive-root", $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot,
    "--archive-record", $fsmcArchiveRecord,
    "--expected-record-digest", $ExpectedRecordDigest,
    "--result-out", $fsmcActionResultOut
  ) + $ExtraArguments
  $fsmcActionExecution = Invoke-FsmcExactResultCommand $fsmcActionArgs $fsmcActionResultOut

  & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:archive-action-result -- --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot --result $fsmcActionResultOut --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord | Out-Host
  $fsmcActionVerifyExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
  if ($fsmcActionVerifyExitCode -ne 0) {
    throw "$Action is not verified (action exit $($fsmcActionExecution.FirstExitCode); exact replay exit $($fsmcActionExecution.ReplayExitCode)); do not advance the CAS digest"
  }
  $fsmcActionResult = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcActionResultOut -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
  if ($fsmcActionResult.action -ne $Action) { throw "$Action result action mismatch" }
  if ($Action -eq "assess-cleanup") {
    if (
      $fsmcActionResult.assessedRecordDigest -ne $ExpectedRecordDigest -or
      $fsmcActionResult.eligibility.assessedRecordDigest -ne $ExpectedRecordDigest -or
      -not $fsmcActionResult.eligibility.eligibilityDigest
    ) { throw "cleanup assessment digest mismatch" }
  } elseif (
    $fsmcActionResult.beforeRecordDigest -ne $ExpectedRecordDigest -or
    -not $fsmcActionResult.afterRecordDigest -or
    -not $fsmcActionResult.mutationReceiptDigest
  ) {
    throw "$Action returned an invalid verified mutation result"
  }
  return $fsmcActionResult
}
```

initial provider binding、reactivation prepare／bind／abort、後継確認、hold変更、未公開discardは必要な時点で次のうちexact 1 actionだけを選ぶ。standard recoveryでは別processで先に`set-incident-hold`、次のfresh processで`prepare-provider-reactivation`を行い、authority ref publish／provider reviewを経てさらにfresh processでbindまたはpost-expiry abortを行う。別actionを後日行う場合もcommon blockから再開してfresh `inspect-current`結果を使う。bindingと後継確認は同processで連結せず、後継確認直後は保持期限が最短でも7日先なのでcleanupへ進めない。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcRecoverIndeterminateHead = $false # 直前operationのresultが未検証ならtrue。verified済みならfalse
$fsmcArchiveSession = Get-FsmcArchiveReadyBinding -RecoverIndeterminateHead $fsmcRecoverIndeterminateHead
if ($null -ne $fsmcArchiveSession.RecoveredResult) {
  Write-Host "prior archive operation recovered and verified at $($fsmcArchiveSession.RecoveredResultPath); start the new action in a fresh process"
  return
}
$fsmcCurrentBinding = $fsmcArchiveSession.Evidence
$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest = $fsmcCurrentBinding.currentRecordDigest
$fsmcPairDigest = $fsmcCurrentBinding.pairDigest
$fsmcMaintenanceAction = "<bind-provider-distribution|prepare-provider-reactivation|bind-provider-reactivation|abort-provider-reactivation|mark-successor-verified|set-incident-hold|clear-incident-hold|discard-unpublished>"
switch ($fsmcMaintenanceAction) {
  "bind-provider-distribution" {
    $fsmcProviderImportRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-or-existing-same-terminal-receipt-external-provider-artifact-import-root>")
    $fsmcProviderImportResult = Join-Path $fsmcProviderImportRoot "provider-distribution-import.json"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderImportRoot)) {
      & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run import:fsmc:provider-distribution-receipt -- `
        --repository "<owner/repository>" `
        --provider-run-id "<exact-provider-run-id>" `
        --provider-run-attempt "<exact-canonical-decimal-attempt>" `
        --artifact-id "<exact-actions-artifact-id>" `
        --artifact-name "<foundation-acceptance-executorSourceSha>" `
        --artifact-archive-sha256 "<exact-upload-artifact-digest>" `
        --receipt-raw-sha256 "<exact-provider-receipt-raw-sha256>" `
        --import-root $fsmcProviderImportRoot `
        --result-out $fsmcProviderImportResult | Out-Host
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "provider distribution artifact import failed" }
    } elseif (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderImportResult -PathType Leaf)) {
      throw "existing provider import root lacks its canonical import result"
    }
    & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:provider-distribution-receipt -- --import-root $fsmcProviderImportRoot --result $fsmcProviderImportResult | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "provider distribution import is not verified" }
    $fsmcProviderImport = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderImportResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($fsmcProviderImport.receiptKind -ne "initial-distribution") { throw "initial distribution receipt kind mismatch" }
    $fsmcProviderDistributionReceipt = Join-Path $fsmcProviderImportRoot "payload/fsmc-provider-distribution-receipt.json"
    $fsmcProviderPreviousDeliveryAuthority = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<latest-post-I11-B-workspace-external-delivery-reforecast-path>")
    $fsmcProviderPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<latest-post-I11-B-delivery-authority-bundle-root>")
    $fsmcProviderDeliveryApprovalInput = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<existing-workspace-external-provider-distributed-owner-approved-input-path>")
    $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryReforecastOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-or-existing-provider-distributed-scheduled-reforecast-path>")
    $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-or-existing-provider-distributed-scheduled-authority-bundle-root>")
    $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecastOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<same-scheduled-path-or-existing-latest-provider-distributed-recovery-head-path>")
    $fsmcProviderDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<same-scheduled-bundle-or-existing-latest-provider-distributed-recovery-bundle-root>")
    $fsmcProviderPreviousManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcProviderPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    $fsmcProviderScheduledReceiptExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryReforecastOut -PathType Leaf
    $fsmcProviderScheduledBundleExists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut -PathType Container
    if ($fsmcProviderScheduledReceiptExists -xor $fsmcProviderScheduledBundleExists) {
      throw "provider-distributed scheduled receipt and bundle must be both absent or both present"
    }
    if (-not $fsmcProviderScheduledReceiptExists) {
      & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run reforecast:fsmc:delivery -- `
        --trigger-kind scheduled `
        --trigger-id PROVIDER-DISTRIBUTED `
        --trigger-evidence $fsmcProviderDistributionReceipt `
        --previous-authority-bundle $fsmcProviderPreviousDeliveryAuthorityBundle `
        --expected-previous-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcProviderPreviousManifest.manifestDigest `
        --previous-authority-latest-ref $fsmcProviderPreviousManifest.latestLogicalRef `
        --previous-authority $fsmcProviderPreviousDeliveryAuthority `
        --approval-input $fsmcProviderDeliveryApprovalInput `
        --receipt-out $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryReforecastOut `
        --next-authority-bundle-out $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut | Out-Host
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "provider-distributed delivery reforecast failed" }
    }
    $fsmcProviderScheduledManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:delivery-reforecast -- --authority-bundle $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut --expected-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcProviderScheduledManifest.manifestDigest --authority-latest-ref $fsmcProviderScheduledManifest.latestLogicalRef --expected-latest-authority $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryReforecastOut | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "provider-distributed scheduled reforecast is not verified" }
    if (
      -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecastOut -PathType Leaf) -or
      -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut -PathType Container)
    ) {
      throw "latest provider-distributed receipt or bundle is missing; produce an owner-approved recovery bundle before local bind"
    }
    $fsmcProviderLatestManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fsmcProviderDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut "manifest.json") -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:delivery-reforecast -- --authority-bundle $fsmcProviderDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut --expected-authority-bundle-digest $fsmcProviderLatestManifest.manifestDigest --authority-latest-ref $fsmcProviderLatestManifest.latestLogicalRef --expected-latest-authority $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecastOut --required-ancestor-ref $fsmcProviderScheduledManifest.latestLogicalRef --required-ancestor-authority $fsmcProviderScheduledDeliveryReforecastOut | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "latest provider-distributed scheduled/recovery chain is not verified" }
    $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecast = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecastOut -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    $fsmcProviderDeliveryTriggerValid = (
```
