```powershell
      ($fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecast.trigger.kind -eq "scheduled" -and $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecast.trigger.triggerId -eq "PROVIDER-DISTRIBUTED") -or
      $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecast.trigger.kind -eq "recovery"
    )
    if (
      -not $fsmcProviderDeliveryTriggerValid -or
      $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecast.featureAdmission -ne "go" -or
      $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecast.milestones[7].status -ne "completed" -or
      $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecast.milestones[8].status -ne "completed"
    ) { throw "provider-distributed reforecast did not close M7/M8 with feature admission go" }
    $fsmcActionResult = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction $fsmcMaintenanceAction $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @(
      "--provider-distribution-receipt", $fsmcProviderDistributionReceipt,
      "--provider-distribution-import-receipt", $fsmcProviderImportResult,
      "--expected-provider-distribution-import-receipt-digest", $fsmcProviderImport.importReceiptDigest,
      "--delivery-authority-bundle", $fsmcProviderDeliveryAuthorityBundleOut,
      "--expected-delivery-authority-bundle-digest", $fsmcProviderLatestManifest.manifestDigest,
      "--delivery-authority-latest-ref", $fsmcProviderLatestManifest.latestLogicalRef,
      "--delivery-reforecast-receipt", $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecastOut,
      "--expected-delivery-reforecast-receipt-digest", $fsmcProviderDeliveryReforecast.receiptDigest
    )
  }
  "prepare-provider-reactivation" {
    $fsmcRequestedRecoveryAction = "<rollback|redeploy-standard>"
    $fsmcActionResult = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction $fsmcMaintenanceAction $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @(
      "--requested-recovery-action", $fsmcRequestedRecoveryAction
    )
  }
  "bind-provider-reactivation" {
    $fsmcProviderImportRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-external-provider-reactivation-artifact-import-root>")
    $fsmcProviderImportResult = Join-Path $fsmcProviderImportRoot "provider-reactivation-import.json"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderImportRoot) { throw "provider reactivation artifact import root must be fresh" }
    & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run import:fsmc:provider-distribution-receipt -- `
      --repository "<owner/repository>" `
      --provider-run-id "<exact-provider-run-id>" `
      --provider-run-attempt "<exact-canonical-decimal-attempt>" `
      --artifact-id "<exact-actions-artifact-id>" `
      --artifact-name "<foundation-archive-recovery-execution-executorSourceSha>" `
      --artifact-archive-sha256 "<exact-upload-artifact-digest>" `
      --receipt-raw-sha256 "<exact-provider-reactivation-receipt-raw-sha256>" `
      --import-root $fsmcProviderImportRoot `
      --result-out $fsmcProviderImportResult | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "provider reactivation artifact import failed" }
    & $fsmcFormalActionCommand run verify:fsmc:provider-distribution-receipt -- --import-root $fsmcProviderImportRoot --result $fsmcProviderImportResult | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "provider reactivation import is not verified" }
    $fsmcProviderImport = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcProviderImportResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($fsmcProviderImport.receiptKind -ne "reactivation") { throw "provider reactivation receipt kind mismatch" }
    $fsmcProviderReactivationReceipt = Join-Path $fsmcProviderImportRoot "payload/fsmc-provider-reactivation-receipt.json"
    $fsmcActionResult = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction $fsmcMaintenanceAction $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @(
      "--provider-reactivation-receipt", $fsmcProviderReactivationReceipt,
      "--provider-reactivation-import-receipt", $fsmcProviderImportResult,
      "--expected-provider-reactivation-import-receipt-digest", $fsmcProviderImport.importReceiptDigest
    )
  }
  "abort-provider-reactivation" {
    $fsmcAuthorityKeyDigest = "<pending-authority-key-digest>"
    $fsmcActionResult = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction $fsmcMaintenanceAction $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @(
      "--authority-key-digest", $fsmcAuthorityKeyDigest
    )
  }
  "mark-successor-verified" {
    $fsmcSuccessorArchiveRecord = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<absolute-successor-record-path>")
    $fsmcActionResult = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction $fsmcMaintenanceAction $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @("--successor-record", $fsmcSuccessorArchiveRecord)
  }
  "set-incident-hold" {
    $fsmcActionResult = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction $fsmcMaintenanceAction $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @("--reason-code", "<bounded-reason-code>")
  }
  "clear-incident-hold" {
    $fsmcActionResult = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction $fsmcMaintenanceAction $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @("--reason-code", "<bounded-reason-code>")
  }
  "discard-unpublished" {
    $fsmcActionResult = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction $fsmcMaintenanceAction $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @("--expected-pair-digest", $fsmcPairDigest, "--reason-code", "<bounded-reason-code>")
  }
  default { throw "choose exactly one archive maintenance action" }
}
$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest = $fsmcActionResult.afterRecordDigest
```

`prepare-provider-reactivation`成功だけではprovider operationをdispatchしない。operatorが続行を選ぶ場合はfresh processでcommon blockと`inspect-current`を再実行し、pending key／current record digestを確認して次のpublisherだけを実行する。resultの3値をstandard recovery requestへそのまま渡し、手入力authority path、別record digest、force pushは使わない。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcFormalActionCommand = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath "scripts/fsmc/invoke-formal-package-action.ps1" -ErrorAction Stop).Path
$fsmcArchiveSession = Get-FsmcArchiveReadyBinding -RecoverIndeterminateHead $false
if ($null -ne $fsmcArchiveSession.RecoveredResult) { throw "restart after verifying the recovered prepare result" }
$fsmcCurrentBinding = $fsmcArchiveSession.Evidence
if ($null -eq $fsmcCurrentBinding.pendingProviderReactivation) { throw "no pending provider reactivation authority exists" }
$fsmcAuthorityPublicationResult = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("<fresh-provider-reactivation-authority-publication-result-path>")
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fsmcAuthorityPublicationResult) { throw "authority publication result path must be fresh" }
& $fsmcFormalActionCommand run publish:fsmc:provider-reactivation-authority-ref -- `
  --archive-root $fsmcDurableArchiveRoot `
  --archive-record $fsmcArchiveRecord `
  --expected-record-digest $fsmcCurrentBinding.currentRecordDigest `
  --result-out $fsmcAuthorityPublicationResult | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "provider reactivation authority publication failed; do not dispatch recovery" }
$fsmcAuthorityPublication = Get-Content -LiteralPath $fsmcAuthorityPublicationResult -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
if (
  [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string] $fsmcAuthorityPublication.ref) -or
  [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string] $fsmcAuthorityPublication.evidenceSourceSha) -or
  [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string] $fsmcAuthorityPublication.authorityRawSha256) -or
  $fsmcAuthorityPublication.authorityKeyDigest -ne $fsmcCurrentBinding.pendingProviderReactivation.authorityKeyDigest -or
  $fsmcAuthorityPublication.remoteRepository -ne $fsmcCurrentBinding.pendingProviderReactivation.providerRepository
) { throw "provider reactivation authority publication binding mismatch" }
Write-Host "Use exact authority request fields: ref=$($fsmcAuthorityPublication.ref), evidenceSourceSha=$($fsmcAuthorityPublication.evidenceSourceSha), sha256=$($fsmcAuthorityPublication.authorityRawSha256)"
```

`max(currentEffectiveActivation.effectiveAt + 30日, successorEffectiveActivation.effectiveAt + 7日)`の期限を迎え、current／successor両方のinitial distributionと全reactivation chainから導出したeffective activationがvalid、pending reactivationがnull、providerのfresh active-standard observationがsuccessorを参照してpredecessorを参照せず、incident holdが解除された後の別processだけが次を実行する。そのprocessでもcommon blockを再実行してcurrent CASと4 observationを取り直す。診断がnot eligibleなら正常な保留として理由を表示してmutation 0件で終了し、eligibleでも`cleanup-published`自身が同じlock内でfresh eligibilityを再計算してから削除する。

```powershell
[Console]::InputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$OutputEncoding           = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
chcp 65001 > $null
if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne "Core" -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) {
  throw "FSMC normative PowerShell blocks require pwsh Core 7 or later"
}

$fsmcRecoverIndeterminateHead = $false # 直前operationのresultが未検証ならtrue。verified済みならfalse
$fsmcArchiveSession = Get-FsmcArchiveReadyBinding -RecoverIndeterminateHead $fsmcRecoverIndeterminateHead
if ($null -ne $fsmcArchiveSession.RecoveredResult) {
  Write-Host "prior archive operation recovered and verified at $($fsmcArchiveSession.RecoveredResultPath); run assessment in a fresh process"
  return
}
$fsmcCurrentBinding = $fsmcArchiveSession.Evidence
$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest = $fsmcCurrentBinding.currentRecordDigest
$fsmcPairDigest = $fsmcCurrentBinding.pairDigest
$fsmcAssessment = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction "assess-cleanup" $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @("--expected-pair-digest", $fsmcPairDigest)
if ($fsmcAssessment.eligibility.kind -ne "eligible") {
  $fsmcReasons = $fsmcAssessment.eligibility.reasons -join ", "
  Write-Host "cleanup remains blocked: $fsmcReasons"
  return
}
$fsmcActionResult = Invoke-FsmcArchiveAction "cleanup-published" $fsmcArchiveRecordDigest @("--expected-pair-digest", $fsmcPairDigest)
$fsmcArchiveRecordDigest = $fsmcActionResult.afterRecordDigest
```

### verification record

gate実行中はworkspace外local Markdownへ次だけを記録し、全command成功後に必要なsummaryだけをPR本文へ転記する。これはmachine receiptのpost-Exit human projectionであり、pre-Exit closure、DoD assessment、Exit receiptの代替authorityやhash inputにしない。repository内へ途中recordを書いてclean candidateを壊さず、raw log、screenshot、trace、build directory、Backup実データはuploadしない。

### 無課金確認checklist

- AWS account／S3／KMS／CloudTrail／BudgetsをFSMC用に作成・使用していない
- FSMC専用GitHub Actions jobで`upload-artifact`／`download-artifact`、GHCR、paid runner、Protected Environmentを使っておらず、既存foundation artifactをFSMC証跡へ流用していない
- public標準runnerの無課金利用が不明な場合はCIを起動せずlocal commandで代替した
- BrowserStack、実機farm、Mapbox／Google Maps等の有料API、有料npm製品を追加していない
- required反復testはFSMC-owned PR critical path 20分、performance 5分、release quick 20分、optional Actions job外枠35分の上限内で、最大並列2／retry 0である。QMAXはowner Exitの別枠one-timeとしてBackup／Map各10分、Route 2分で各exact 1回、`qualificationSurfaceDigest`変更時だけ再実行する
